title: Metal Slug X: Super Vehicle - 001
description: Metal Slug X is an upgraded version of Metal Slug 2, featuring the Metal Slug 3 game engine. The story remains the same but there are slight changes to music, gameplay and interactions.

title: Virtua Fighter 2
description: The second game in Sega-AM2's signature 3D fighting game series builds upon its predecessor with significantly improved graphics, new gameplay mechanics, and two new fighters.

title: Baldur's Gate
description: Bioware's first RPG, you must assemble a party of adventurers and investigate the mystery of the iron crisis and a darker threat that looms in the city of Baldur's Gate.

title: Beyond Oasis
description: An Action/RPG for the Sega Genesis.

title: Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance
description: Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance serves as the first incarnation of the Fire Emblem franchise to embrace the realm of the third dimension while continuing the series' focus on turn based combat in a medieval setting.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories
description: Use your cards and battle in this game based on the popular anime.

title: Ultima VII: The Black Gate
description: The Avatar returns to the world of Britannia to face a new threat from a mysterious cult and its enigmatic god known as the Guardian in the seventh game of the Ultima series.

title: The Revenge of Shinobi
description: Often considered the franchise's pinnacle, The Revenge of Shinobi features a wide variety of locations, and a soundtrack by Yuzo Koshiro of Streets of Rage fame. In early versions, it also featured bosses who bore a striking resemblance to characters not owned by Sega.

title: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior
description: The one-on-one arcade fighting game that kicked off the "fighting game revolution" of the 1990s. Play as one of eight martial artists and travel the world to knock your opponents out of the tournament!

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert
description: Set in an alternate universe, Command & Conquer: Red Alert shows the reality of a different World War II where a powerful Soviet Union under leader Stalin tries to seize power over large areas in Asia & Europe.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game
description: A family-friendly video game adaptation of the Star Wars prequel trilogy, styled in the LEGO Star Wars line of toys.

title: Tales of Phantasia
description: The first entry in the "Tales" RPG series, Tales of Phantasia centers around a group of unwitting time travelers as they try to stop the Evil King Dhaos and reverse the decay of their world.

title: Golden Sun
description: Golden Sun sees the player travel Weyard to stop the release of Alchemy before it destroys the world.

title: Hokuto no Ken 7 : Seiken Retsuden: Denshousha e no Michi
description: A fighting game based on the Fist of the North Star franchise. It is the third of three FoNS games for the Super Famicom.

title: The Legend of Kyrandia
description: The first in a series of humorous fantasy point and click adventure games, it puts the player in the shoes of unlikely hero Brandon, who must stop the mad jester Malcolm from destroying the land.

title: Donkey Kong
description: Control Jumpman (later known as Mario) and save his girlfriend, Pauline, from the evil barrel-tossing gorilla known as Donkey Kong. Designed by Shigeru Miyamoto, this was the game that set the template for the platformer genre.

title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire
description: You're in the Hot Seat! You have 15 questions and 3 lifelines. This is just like the TV Show!

title: The House of the Dead
description: As AMS agents, G or Thomas Rogan, you are sent to investigate a panicked phone call from Rogan's fiancée, Sophie Richards and the disappearances of scientists working in the Curien Mansion. But can you prepare for what lies in the House Of The Dead?

title: Tales of Eternia
description: Tales of Eternia is the third game in Namco's series of JRPGs, originally released in the US as "Tales of Destiny II" for the PlayStation.

title: Star Ocean: The Second Story
description: Discover the world of Expel in this popular JRPG from Tri-Ace.

title: Doom II: Hell on Earth
description: After the events of Doom, Hell has found its way to Earth. The last living scientists develop a plan to evacuate what's remaining of the human race with enormous space ships. Unfortunately, the demons have taken control of the only spaceport, and it's up to the nameless space marine to take it back.

title: Lode Runner
description: Lode Runner is a 2D platform/Puzzle game from 1983 created by Douglas Smith. It is one of the first games to include a level editor tool for players to create their own levels.

title: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?
description:
Educational game in which you need to follow clues in order to find Carmen Sandiego. 
You will visit a lot of different locations all over the world.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi
description: An alternate fighting game take on the Dragon Ball manga and anime series, Budokai Tenkaichi utilizes a third-person perspective and unified movelists while adding a very large playable character roster.

title: Mystaria: The Realms of Lore
description: An early Strategy Role Playing Game for the Sega Saturn.

title: Ehrgeiz: God Bless the Ring
description: A 3D fighting game featuring free-form movement and guest characters from Square's hit JRPG Final Fantasy VII. The console version features a bonus action RPG built from the "Quest Mode" in the developer's earlier Tobal series.

title: NBA 2K2
description: NBA 2K2 brings the NBA 2K series of realistic basketball games to all sixth-generation consoles, updating the roster to the 2001/2002 NBA season while adding a new "Fantasy Mode", where every player in the season is put into the drafting pool.

title: Heart of Darkness
description: When Andy's dog Whisky is kidnapped during a solar eclipse, the brave youth embarks on a 2D platforming adventure across dangerous alien landscapes to rescue him.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 3
description: The third instalment in the Pro Evolution Soccer franchise makes a number of improvements on the classic footballing formula.

title: Destruction Derby
description: Destruction Derby is a racing-type game developed by Reflections. It was first released for PlayStation and PC in 1995, followed by a Sega Saturn version later on.

title: Metal Slug 2: Super Vehicle - 001/II
description: Metal Slug 2 sees Marco Rossi once again do battle to save the world from the evil General Morden and a mysterious foe from above.

title: Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening
description: The third game in Capcom's popular action adventure series. This is a prequel to the original Devil May Cry and the first game of the franchise's storyline chronologically. The game saw a re-release in Devil May Cry 3: Special Edition, which added a new character, among other things.

title: Real Bout Fatal Fury
description: The fifth installment of SNK's Fatal Fury franchise, completely changing the button layout while introducing the Power Gauge and featuring unique ring-out stages.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater returns with new levels, skaters, gameplay mechanics (including the introduction of the Manual), and the ability to create custom skaters and levels.

title: Runaway: A Road Adventure
description: On a dark night, Brian Brisco accidentally hits a girl on run from the mob. Before he knows it, they're both being chased all because of a peculiar Aztec relic in their possession. A contemporary point and click adventure in the vein of earlier Lucas Arts classics.

title: Metal Slug 3
description: The third game in the Metal Slug series, first released to arcades in 2000 and later ported to many home consoles, PCs, and mobile devices.

title: Flashback: The Quest for Identity
description: It's 2142 and the player is Conrad B. Hart, an agent for the Galaxia Bureau of Investigation. He must recover his lost memories to save Earth before it's too late.

title: Diablo II
description: The sequel to Blizzard's popular action-RPG features a larger and more varied world, new playable classes, and expanded skill trees. Even moreso than its predecessor, Diablo II would provide a blueprint followed by many later RPGs and action games.

title: Fire Emblem: Fuuin no Tsurugi
description: Fūin no Tsurugi follows the tale of Roy, son of Eliwood, on his quest across Elibe to strike down Bern and its twisted leader, Zephiel.

title: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones
description: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones is the eighth game in the Fire Emblem series. At the time of its release, it was only the second game in the franchise to be released outside of Japan.

title: Baten Kaitos Origins
description: Baten Kaitos Origins is a prequel to Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean. Its story revolves around Sagi, and his spirit guide.

title: Syphon Filter
description: Syphon Filter is a third person shooter for the original PlayStation. Its action-oriented gameplay set it apart from Metal Gear Solid.

title: Bust-A-Move 4
description: The fourth entry in the Bust-A-Move series adds a new character roster, some new gameplay elements, and a brand new story involving the inhabitants of Rainbow World.

title: Trials of Mana
description: The third entry in the World of Mana franchise. First released on Super Famicom, it remained a Japan-exclusive for almost 25 years until its appearance in the Collection of Mana compilation for Nintendo Switch.

title: Street Fighter Alpha 3
description: The last and largest installment of the Street Fighter Alpha trilogy adds even more characters while adding three unique "fighting styles" (each with special abilities and traits). GO FOR BROKE!

title: Pocket Fighter
description: A casual fighting game spin-off of the versus puzzle game Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo, featuring super-deformed versions of numerous fighters from the Street Fighter and Darkstalkers series.

title: Super Mario World
description: One of the few launch titles of the SNES (and bundled with the system in North America and Europe), the fifth main game in the Super Mario series brings the Mario brothers into the mysterious Dinosaur Land. It marks the first appearance of Mario's dinosaur companions, known as Yoshi.

title: Tales of Destiny
description: Tales of Destiny is the second entry in the Tales of series of Action RPGs. It was developed by Wolf Team and published by Namco.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer
description: With engaging gameplay and its deep Master League mode, Pro Evolution Soccer set the foundations for Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo's successful soccer simulation franchise

title: Mortal Kombat 3
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic Earthrealm (invaded by Shao Kahn's army of Outworld), Mortal Kombat 3 is the third installment of one of the most violent fighting game franchises of all time.

title: Lemmings
description: Guide hordes of helpless green-haired rodents away from peril in this landmark puzzle game.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Battle 22
description: A PlayStation spin-off of the Super Butoden series, Ultimate Battle 22 features cel-drawn character sprites from the animators of the original Dragon Ball Z animated series. It is also the first game in the series to be released throughout all of Europe and was released in North America nearly ten years later.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Shin Budokai - Another Road
description: The second handheld spinoff of the Dragon Ball Z: Budokai series, Another Road features a new original story involving the resurrection of Majin Buu in the "alternate" timeline.

title: Fire Emblem
description: The seventh game in the Fire Emblem series and a prequel to Fire Emblem: Fuin no Tsurugi, released for the Game Boy Advance. It is the first Fire Emblem game to be released outside of Japan.

title: Darkstalkers 3
description: The third (and final) major installment of Capcom's horror-themed fighting game series adds a variety of new characters and major gameplay changes (such as changing the round-based system to a lives-based system).

title: Resident Evil 4
description: Special agent Leon S. Kennedy travels to rural Spain to rescue the U.S. President's kidnapped daughter in Resident Evil's sixth canonical installment. It is notable for a lengthy development cycle which involved a complete overhaul of the series' established gameplay mechanics.

title: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes
description: Intergalactic Bounty Hunter Samus Aran struggles to rid Aether of darkness and the Ing Horde in the second 3D Metroid game for the Nintendo GameCube.

title: Skies of Arcadia
description: Vyse, a sky pirate, travels in his airship to stop the Valuan Empire's conquest of the world.

title: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike
description: The third and final iteration of Street Fighter III, including a wealth of gameplay and design revisions while introducing several new combatants.

title: Ikari Warriors
description: A top-down shooter where one or two bandana-wearing commandos fight enemy forces in a jungle. It is notable for allowing the player to pilot various vehicles including a tank and a helicopter.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
description: Run, jump and spin through levels as Sonic and Tails, in order to thwart the plans of the nefarious Dr. Robotnik and free the kidnapped animals! Released by Sega in 1992, Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is often considered one of the greatest platformers of all time.

title: Double Dragon
description: An official 2D fighting game adaptation of the Double Dragon series and the only game that is loosely based on the 1994 film of the same name.

title: Tetris
description: This shape-based Russian mind-bender set the stage for innumerable puzzle games to follow.

title: The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse
description: When Pluto is dog-napped by the evil Emperor Pete, Mickey Mouse sets out to rescue him (with the help of several magical costumes with special abilities).

title: Metal Slug 4
description: Utilizing similar gameplay mechanics as previous Metal Slug games, Metal Slug 4 stays true to the series, but also manages to keep things fresh with new bosses, weapons, vehicles, and a combo system.

title: Dead or Alive 2
description: The first sequel to Tecmo's signature 3D fighting game series, Dead or Alive 2 features an improved visual style and new multi-tiered environments (filled with their own unique hazards and sizes).

title: World Soccer Winning Eleven 9
description: World Soccer Winning Eleven 9/Pro Evolution Soccer 5 was the game was the first game in the series to feature online network play.

title: Ridge Racer
description: Ridge Racer is an arcade racing game that was considered innovative upon its release.  It has spawned a successful franchise of games focused on over-the-top drift racing. Released for the powerful Namco System 22 arcade system, it was the first mass-market video game to use texture-mapped 3D polygon graphics and Gouraud shading.

title: Sega Rally Championship
description: A rally racing arcade game by Sega, giving drivers the choice between a Toyota Celica or Lancia Delta as they take on asphalt, gravel, dirt, and mud to earn the best time.

title: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3
description: Considered one of the most competitive fighting games out of the entire franchise, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 is an update to the third installment that brings back masked ninjas while tweaking character balances.

title: The Lucky Dime Caper starring Donald Duck
description: Join Donald Duck in his quest to recover Uncle Scrooge's Number One Dime and save his three nephews Huey, Dewey, and Louie.

title: Wild Arms
description: Wild Arms tells the tale of a treasure hunter, princess, and dream chaser on a quest to save the world of Filgaia from the invasion of the metal demons.

title: Sword of Mana
description: Choose a male or female character to experience different versions of the story in this enhanced remake of the first game in the Seiken Densetsu/Mana series.

title: Dragon Quest VII: Fragments of the Forgotten Past
description: The seventh numbered entry in the Dragon Quest franchise, originally released for the PlayStation and later remade for the Nintendo 3DS.

title: Bust-A-Move 2: Arcade Edition
description: Taito's cutesy puzzle spin-off of Bubble Bobble returns for a second round, adding new gameplay mechanics and the ability to play Versus Mode with computer-controlled opponents.

title: Star Wars: X-Wing
description: A space combat simulation set in the Star Wars universe, Star Wars: X-Wing lets players pilot the signature starfighters of the Rebel Alliance in a variety of different scenarios, ultimately culminating in the destruction of the original Death Star.

title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII
description: A prequel to the fan favorite Final Fantasy VII, focusing on Zack Fair and his adventures as a member of SOLDIER in Shinra Corporation.

title: Fatal Fury
description: SNK's first fighting game and the first fighting game on the Neo Geo, telling the tale of a trio of martial artists participating in a local tournament to seek revenge on the crime boss that sponsors it.

title: Pikmin
description: The intrepid Captain Olimar crash-lands on a mysterious planet. With the help of strange creatures called Pikmin, Olimar must escape the planet within thirty days before his life support expires.

title: Max Payne
description: Remedy's film-noir action game puts players in the role of grizzled cop Max Payne as he tries to clear his name of murder.

title: Gran Turismo
description: Polyphony Digital's seminal racing simulator for the PlayStation.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Hyper Dimension
description: The final adaptation of the series to be released on the Super Famicom, featuring a less-cartoonish visual approach and more traditional fighting game mechanics.

title: R4 Ridge Racer Type 4
description: Released for the PlayStation at the end of 1998, Ridge Racer Type 4 is the fourth console entry of Namco's arcade racing series. Aside from being a further improvement from the already impressive Rage Racer, R4 also contains highly detailed conversations with various racing teams, a concept that would be taken to the next level with the later spinoff R: Racing Evolution.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog
description: The inaugural game in Sega's flagship series starring Sega's most iconic character the blue hedgehog known as Sonic. Sonic the Hedgehog infused conventional platforming with thrilling speed.

title: Pikmin 2
description: Pikmin 2 continues the adventures of Captain Olimar as he returns to the planet he spent so long trying to escape. His mission: collect treasures to prevent his company from going bankrupt.

title: Prince of Persia
description: Prince of Persia is the original Persian adventure by Jordan Mechner and the first game in a multi-million dollar franchise.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
description: One of the launch titles of the original Xbox, Halo: Combat Evolved is a sci-fi first-person shooter telling the tale of an advanced cybernetic super-soldier known as the "Master Chief".

title: Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes
description: One of the most legendary crossover fighting game series is thrown into high gear with a whopping 56-character roster and new three-on-three tag-team gameplay.

title: Romancing SaGa 3
description: A Super Famicom RPG that is part of the popular (in Japan) SaGa series. It follows the non-linear structure of previous games in the series as well as after.

title: Crush
description: Danny, an insomniac young adult, must traipse through several puzzle-laden sections of his traumatized subconscious using Dr. Reuben's C.R.U.S.H. machine, which allows Danny to solve puzzles by turning the whole world from 3D into 2D, and vice-versa.

title: Outcast
description: Critically lauded but commercially unsuccessful in the United States, Belgian developer Appeal's swan song was ahead of its time and has gained a cult following. Shoot, scan, and smash pots on a variety of alien landscapes.

title: NBA Jam Extreme
description: The first in a series of post-Midway NBA Jam games, NBA Jam Extreme brings the arcade-action series to 3D.

title: Duck Hunt
description: Duck Hunt was one of the original NES launch titles, featuring a lightgun, ducks and a laughing blood-hound.

title: Art of Fighting
description: SNK's second foray into the fighting game genre, known for its dedicated linear story, camera zooming effect (allowing for large character sprites in close-range combat), and the introduction of a gauge that depletes when certain moves are used.

title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island
description: A spin-off of the Super Mario platforming series, Yoshi's Island puts players in control of a tribe of Yoshies as they guide the infant Mario past the forces of the evil Kamek.

title: F1 2000
description: Formula One racing game released in 2000 and based on the 2000 F1 World Championship.

title: Super Mario 64
description: Super Mario 64 takes the Mario franchise into polygonal worlds, setting numerous standards for 3D game design along the way.

title: Half-Life
description: Take on the role of Gordon Freeman as he escapes the disastrous aftermath of an experiment gone wrong in the Black Mesa Research Facility.

title: Tomb Raider
description: Tomb Raider stars Lara Croft in her first title as she races through the jungles of Peru to the sands of Egypt in pursuit of the Scion, an ancient artifact reputedly holding the key to the ancient mystery of Atlantis itself. It would later be remade as Tomb Raider Anniversary.

title: Breath of Fire II
description: The sequel to Breath of Fire, centering around a descendant of the Dragon Clan, Ryu. He has the ability to transform into a dragon and, together with his friends, must fight a powerful demon lord to save the world. The game was originally released in 1994.

title: Alone in the Dark
description: Widely considered to be the first survival horror game to use polygonal graphics. Initially released on the PC by Interplay, and developed by Infogrames, in 1992, Alone in the Dark would go down as a historical landmark in video gaming history.

title: Mega Man 3
description: An alternate Mega Man 3 that is the sequel to the original DOS Mega Man.

title: GoldenEye 007
description: A first-person shooter for the Nintendo 64 and a video game tie-in with the 1995 James Bond film GoldenEye. It paved the way for a long line of shooter games based on the universe of the British secret agent and is often credited for helping establish first-person shooters for consoles.

title: Shining Force III Scenario 3
description: The third volume of Shining Force III that follows the adventures of a mercenary from the previous volumes named Julian.

title: California Games
description: California Games is a multiple event sports game released on multiple 8-bit and 16-bit computers, consoles and handhelds. Developed by 80s legends Epyx, with a reputation for producing multiple-event games, traditional sports were abandoned to accommodate less-established pursuits associated with The Golden State.

title: Pokémon Diamond/Pearl
description: Pokémon Diamond and Pearl are the first iteration of Pokémon games to appear on the Nintendo DS. Both Games are set in the world of Sinnoh, which habitats 493 different species of Pokémon.

title: Fable
description: Fable is the first game in the Fable franchise, following the exploits of an unnamed Hero as he struggles to free Albion from the evil Jack Of Blades. Fable features a moral choice system, where your appearance changes depending on your actions.

title: Battle Arena Toshinden 2
description: Released close to its main competitor (Soul Edge), the sequel to the first-ever 3D weapon-based fighting game brings its blades to arcades (for its first and only time).

title: FIFA Soccer 97
description: A soccer/football game. The fourth game in the FIFA series.

title: Samurai Shodown V
description: Created after Playmore's acquisition of SNK, this prequel to the entire Samurai Shodown series completely revamps the button layout again (adding a new Dodge button, bringing back the second game's maneuvers for good use) while adding a variety of new combatants.

title: Duke Nukem 3D
description: Kill countless aliens while rescuing babes as Duke Nukem in this critically acclaimed first-person shooter.

title: Paperboy
description: An arcade game that originally came out in 1985, the goal of Paperboy is to go from house to house delivering papers while avoiding obstacles.

title: MediEvil
description: Step back in time to the mystical land of Gallowmere and assume the role of Sir Daniel Fortesque as he attempts to stop the return of the evil sorceror Zarok.

title: Mortal Kombat II
description: The second installment of one of the most violent fighting game franchises of all time, providing a smoother fighting system while adding new fighters, Fatalities, babalities, friendships, and much more.

title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
description: The eighth main entry in the Dragon Quest franchise. It was the first game in the series to utilize a full 3D environment and featured a cel-shaded graphics style which would become standard for all future games in the franchise.

title: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis
description: Indiana Jones follows an ancient medallion around the world to discover the secret of Atlantis before the Nazis can wield its terrible power in this classic LucasArts point-and-click adventure.

title: Power Stone 2
description: Power Stone 2 is a classic 3D fighting arena video game developed by Capcom for the Sega Dreamcast. It is a sequel of the Power Stone released in 1999.

title: Grand Theft Auto III
description: The third release in the Grand Theft Auto Franchise stars silent criminal protagonist Claude who, after having been betrayed and left for dead, is out for revenge. It was the first GTA game in 3D, an evolution that proved to be pivotal and helped establish the franchise as one of gaming's most popular (and controversial).

title: Phantom Brave
description: Phantom Brave is a strategy RPG for the PlayStation 2, and the first game to be published by NIS America.

title: Persona 2: Innocent Sin
description: The first game in the Persona 2 duology, Persona 2: Innocent Sin is a JRPG developed and published by Atlus for the Playstation. The game follows Tatsuya Suo and friends as they investigate the rumors surrounding Sumaru City.

title: Thousand Arms
description: Thousand Arms is a JRPG game with dating sim elements. Help Meis Triumph upgrade his weapons by combining love and a red hot forge. Don't forget to use said weapons to destroy the evil robotic Dark Acolytes.

title: NBA Live 2000
description: The first basketball game since Michael Jordan In Flight to officially feature Michael Jordan in the game. NBA Live 2000 features Tim Duncan of the 1999 NBA Champion San Antonio Spurs on the cover.

title: Dead or Alive
description: The first in Tecmo's signature 3D fighting game series, Dead or Alive introduces the world to a special "rock-paper-scissors" system with strikes, grapples, and counter-attacks.

title: Mother 3
description: Mother 3 is the third game in Shigesato Itoi's critically acclaimed Mother series. In the game, Lucas and various other protagonists fight to defeat a large army known as the Pig Army who are ruining their otherwise peaceful lives.

title: Striker Pro 2000
description: Uefa Striker is a soccer game for the Playstation and Dreamcast based around playing as some of the biggest European clubs.

title: Digimon World
description: Digimon world is a game that allows a player to raise their own Digimon and teach it to battle.

title: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future
description: In a future world were mankind and dolphins live together as equals, an alien force known as the Foe seeks to end this happy existence. The Foe damages the Earth's defense system, and alters history for the worse. One extraordinary dolphin, Ecco, must travel through time to set things right.

title: Pokémon Red/Blue
description: Pokémon Red version and Blue version were the initial two releases in the Pokémon franchise. Red, a Pokémon trainer from Pallet Town who Ash Ketchum, the anime protagonist, was later based on, starts a journey to become a Pokémon Master and ultimately catch 'em all.

title: Star Fox
description: As the leader of an elite squad of anthropomorphic animal pilots, fly throughout the Lylat star system in the prototype Arwing spacecraft to prevent the galactic conquest of a mad scientist in this 3D shooter for the SNES (with real-time polygonal graphics powered by the new Super FX chip).

title: Dino Crisis 2
description: As Dylan Morton and Regina, fight your through countless dinosaurs to uncover the mystery of how an island was to vanish from the face of the earth.

title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
description: Sequel to the popular adventure game Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars. George and Nico are embroiled in yet another mysterious escapade of brutality, calamity and immorality.

title: The King of Fighters '97
description: The fourth installment in SNK's tag-team fighting game series, bringing the "Orochi Saga" to its climax. It's known for introducing the short-lived "Command Mode" system, allowing players to choose from two distinct playstyles.

title: Lucky Luke
description: Lucky Luke is based on the Franco-Belgian comic by the same name.

title: Arc the Lad III
description: Arc The Lad III takes place several years after Arc II, introducing you to the world that was created from those events.

title: Albert Odyssey: Legend of Eldean
description: Albert Odyssey: Legend of Eldean is a turn based Japanese role-playing game developed by Sunsoft and published in North America by Working Designs July 1997.

title: Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete
description: Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete is the sequel to Lunar: Sliver Star Story. The game features a brand new cast of characters and takes place 1000 years after the events of the original game.

title: The King of Fighters '94
description: Pitting together fighters from SNK's other franchises, The King of Fighters '94 introduces a new team-based system where players fight in teams of three, eliminating each combatant in one-on-one rounds.

title: Silent Hill
description: Everyman Harry Mason searches the desolate town of Silent Hill for his missing daughter in the first of a series of survival horror titles that rely more on unsettling atmosphere than jump scares for tension.

title: Virtua Fighter 4
description: The fourth main installment of the Virtua Fighter series continues its trend of using the most powerful hardware at the time for groundbreaking visuals, while introducing online connectivity for Japanese arcades (allowing players to track their stats and customize their fighters' appearances).

title: Chrono Cross
description: The sequel to the classic Super Nintendo RPG, Chrono Cross expanded the franchise to alternate universes, adopted a turn-based combat system, and had dozens of playable characters.

title: Project Justice
description: Students of Japanese high schools brawl again, this time in teams of three, in this sequel to Rival Schools.

title: Samurai Shodown IV: Amakusa's Revenge
description: After the defeat of the fearsome warrior Zankuro, a sinister castle rises belonging to the evil sorceror Amakusa (the antagonist from the first game) rises in the fourth installment of the Samurai Shodown series.

title: Maniac Mansion: Day of the Tentacle
description: A point-and-click adventure game that follows Bernard Bernoulli, Laverne, and Hoagie as they try to prevent Purple Tentacle from taking over the world.

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3
description: Persona 3 is the fourth main entry in the Persona series. Introducing the "Social Link" system and removing several Shin Megami Tensei staples including the post-apocalyptic setting, Persona 3 greatly expanded the popularity of the series, particularly in the west. It also established the balance of traditional role-playing combat and social simulation that would define the series going forward.

title: Phantasy Star II
description: 16-bit sci-fi RPG originally released on the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive in 1989.

title: International Superstar Soccer 2
description: A Europe only soccer game.

title: Donkey Kong Country 3: Dixie Kong's Double Trouble!
description: In the final chapter of the original Donkey Kong Country trilogy, both Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong are missing. It's up to Dixie Kong (and her younger cousin Kiddy Kong) to find them!

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 2
description: Pro Evolution Soccer 2 marks a return of footballing fun in this second instalment of the popular sports game series.

title: Field Commander
description: At its roots Field Commander is essentially an Advanced Wars clone, but a few unique units, a great multiplayer component, and an amazing map editor help set it apart.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
description: Play as Sonic or Tails to chase down Doctor Robotnik/Eggman once again. This time Sonic must also face a new enemy, Knuckles the Echidna.

title: Metroid Prime 3: Corruption
description: The finale to the Metroid Prime trilogy sees its debut on the Wii.

title: Kingdom Hearts II
description: The third installment in the Kingdom Hearts franchise following after Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, known for its successful combination of Disney and Final Fantasy franchises into a believable plot.

title: Final Fantasy V
description: Join Bartz and his friends on an epic journey spanning the globe in an attempt to stop four mystical crystals from shattering, with a character-customizing Job system that some consider to be the "father" of similar RPGs to come.

title: Double Dragon II: The Revenge
description: Help Billy and Jimmy avenge Marion's death in this sequel to the beat-em-up arcade classic.

title: Mike Tyson's Punch-Out!!
description: A home adaptation of Nintendo's earlier boxing arcade game Punch-Out!!, featuring real-life World Heavyweight Champion Mike "Kid Dynamite" Tyson as the final opponent.

title: Virtua Fighter 4: Evolution
description: The definitive version of Virtua Fighter 4 with two new characters, more characters, and the original Virtual Fighter playable.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters
description: One-on-one combat with the titular Turtles in this trio of TMNT-licensed fighting games developed by Konami for the NES, SNES, and Genesis. The last TMNT game released in the 1990s.

title: Bubble Bobble
description: An early arcade platformer that has 100 levels. Released by Taito in 1986, it was one of the first games to feature two-player cooperative play and multiple endings.

title: Goal Storm '97
description: Goal Storm '97 is the second game in Konami's long running Winning Eleven series.

title: Lumines: Puzzle Fusion
description: This music-based puzzle game from Q Entertainment and Tetsuya Mizuguchi features contributions from numerous Japanese electronic musicians.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky
description: The first game in the Legend of Heroes VI Sora no Kiseki trilogy. Follow Estelle and Joshua Bright on their journey to become Senior Bracers.

title: Illusion of Gaia
description: An action-RPG that tells the story of a boy named Will and his quest to stop a comet from destroying the Earth.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai
description: The first in a long-line of 2.5D fighting games based on the Dragon Ball Z manga and anime series comes, and the first adaptation of the series to be released onto sixth-generation consoles.

title: Koudelka
description: Crawl through the corridors of a building being torn apart at the seams by demonic forces.

title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
description: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time is an action-adventure game with a heavy focus on platforming. The story revolves around the wry Prince, a time-altering dagger, and a kingdom beset by a plague-like evil.

title: Battle Arena Toshinden
description: The first 3D fighting game released for the PlayStation, Battle Arena Toshinden introduces both the side-step maneuver and weapon-based combat to the genre.

title: Mega Man
description: Featuring a robotic protagonist that could siphon the abilities of his adversaries, Mega Man is a side-scrolling platformer that begins the never-ending struggle between cheeky hero Mega Man and the evil roboticist Dr. Wily.

title: Advance Wars 2: Black Hole Rising
description: A direct sequel to the first "Wars" title on Game Boy Advance, featuring a new campaign and an expanded roster of Commanding Officers.

title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
description: The first game in the Oddworld series. Players control an alien slave named Abe on a quest to free his fellow Mudokons from the clutches of Molluck, the ruthless boss of RuptureFarms.

title: Shining Force III Scenario 2
description: The second volume of Shining Force III telling the story of Medion, Prince of Destonia.

title: Destrega
description: A free roaming one on one 3D fighting game by Koei.

title: X-Games: Pro Boarder
description: X-Games: Pro Boarder is a snow boarding game.

title: Killzone: Liberation
description: Take the fight against the Helghast to the small screen in Killzone: Liberation for the PSP.

title: Alundra
description: A PS1 RPG in the vein of Zelda, Alundra has the player control a psychic youth as he combats an ancient evil that threatens to overwhelm the peaceful village of Inoa.

title: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis
description: In the third installment of the survival horror series, Jill Valentine must escape the zombie-infected Raccoon City while being hunted down by a genetically-engineered monster called Nemesis.

title: Fighting Vipers
description: From the creators of the Virtua Fighter series comes a unique 3D fighting game with faster gameplay, walled stages, and a breakable "armor" system.

title: Samurai Shodown
description: Twelve of the fiercest warriors of the late 18th century engage in duels to the death as a dark power rises over Japan in the first weapon-based fighting game for the Neo Geo.

title: Wario World
description: Wario leaps from the handhelds on to the big screen in his first GameCube adventure.

title: Burning Rangers
description: Rescue the injured and extinguish fires in this 3D platformer from Sonic Team.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Idainaru Dragon Ball Densetsu
description: Based on the manga and anime series Dragon Ball Z, Idainaru Dragon Ball Densetsu is a unique fighting game mixing hand-drawn graphics with a free-ranged 3D fighting game system that allows for action-packed three-on-three simultaneous battles.

title: Resident Evil
description: The first in a long line of action-oriented survival-horror games, Resident Evil pits a small group of special forces agents against hordes of zombies and other mutated creatures in a mysterious mansion.

title: Guardian Heroes
description: Combining fighting game mechanics with RPG elements, Guardian Heroes is a 2D beat-em-up for the Sega Saturn that tells the tale of a group of fantasy adventurers, a mystical warrior linked to a powerful sword, the kingdom of a tyrannical wizard, and a war between ethereal beings.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell
description: First entry in the Splinter Cell series.  You are Sam Fisher, a highly-trained covert operative working for a division of the NSA known as Third Echelon. As Sam, you must infiltrate heavily guarded areas in order to combat the threat of terrorism.

title: The King of Fighters '99
description: The King of Fighters '99 is the sixth installment of the King of Fighters series, introducing new gameplay mechanics such as the "Striker" system. It also introduces a new protagonist, K', as well as a new, darker story arc involving the mysterious cartel called NESTS.

title: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit
description: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit is the third entry in the popular NFS franchise and is the first to include high-speed police chases. With an extensive car roster and high-octane racing, NFS III raised the bar on arcade racing games.

title: Diablo
description: An isometric action RPG that takes place in and below the town of Tristram. Gothic fantasy weapons and spells are used to defeat hordes of monsters from hell through randomized dungeon levels, continuously gaining experience points, gold, and a variety of equipment to bolster the hero's monster-killing potency along the way.

title: Kung-Fu Master
description: Help Thomas save his girlfriend, Sylvia, as he battles minions and dragons over five side-scrolling, action packed levels, Kung-Fu style. Based on the Jackie Chan movie Wheels on Meals, Kung-Fu Master (Spartan X in Japan) is often credited for creating the beat 'em up genre.

title: Super Punch-Out!!
description: The second home adaptation of Nintendo's Punch-Out!! series of boxing arcade games, pitting players against sixteen pugilists from around the world (each with their own variety of techniques, a lot of which are illegal).

title: Mario Tennis
description: The second Mario sports game developed by Camelot.  It was the first game to include Waluigi who eventually became a recurring character in Mario games.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
description: Link dons a talking hat named Ezlo as he sets out on a quest to save Princess Zelda and defeat the evil wizard, Vaati.

title: Soul Edge
description: A historical-fantasy weapon-based 3D fighting game from the company behind the Tekken series. Set in 16th century Europe, the game would later spawn numerous sequels under the name Soulcalibur.

title: Metroid Prime: Hunters
description: Metroid comes to the DS with a robust multiplayer component, innovative touch screen control, and a single-player campaign. Hunters takes place in between Metroid Prime and Metroid Prime 2: Echoes in the otherwise unmentioned Alimbic Cluster.

title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
description: The start of something new, Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver drops the overhead view of the original in favor of a third-person perspective with plenty of action and puzzles.

title: FIFA International Soccer
description: The first entry in the popular gaming franchise about the most popular sport in the world. Staring only international teams it is virtually unrecognizable compared to the modern FIFA games.

title: Guitar Hero
description: Guitar Hero allows players to step into the shoes of a rock god and play some of the most famous guitar songs of all time.

title: Final Fantasy VI
description: Formerly known as Final Fantasy III in North America, Final Fantasy VI follows a diverse group of heroes as they fight to defeat Kefka, a megalomaniac intent on using a combination of long-lost magic and technology to take over the world.

title: Shadow of the Colossus
description: Explore the Forbidden Land as Wander, a young warrior who must slay sixteen Colossi in order to restore the life of a sacrificed maiden.

title: Samurai Shodown V Special
description: An enhanced update of Samurai Shodown V, bringing back bosses and "Fatality" effects of older games. It is known as the last official game released for the long-running Neo Geo hardware.

title: Mario Kart DS
description: The first game in the Mario Kart franchise to go online and the fifth overall in the series. It also added a brand new Missions mode to the mix with special challenges to complete.

title: Revelations: Persona
description: The first in the Persona series, released for the PlayStation in 1996. It was later remade and released on the PSP in 2009.

title: Wizards & Warriors
description: An action RPG developed by Rare Ltd. and the first in a trilogy of games for the NES. The game features a swordsman named Kuros saving a number of damsels in distress on his way to defeat the evil wizard Malkil.

title: Super Mario Sunshine
description: While vacationing on tropical Isle Delfino, Mario is framed for vandalism committed by his own shadowy doppelganger, forcing the paroled plumber to clean up the entire island by using a specialized water-spraying device known as F.L.U.D.D.

title: Super Street Fighter II
description: Four new warriors enter the World Warrior tournament in the fourth main iteration of the classic Street Fighter II series. Along with the roster change, the game received numerous graphical and audio upgrades thanks to its more powerful CPS-2 hardware.

title: Castlevania
description: Count Dracula's dark presence has invited the heroic vampire hunter Simon Belmont, who must venture through six stages (filled with horrible monsters) with his trusty vampire-killing whip.

title: Hitman: Codename 47
description: The first entry in the Hitman series has the player take control of Agent 47, who is expertly trained in the art of assassination. His missions take him to a variety of locations, targeting decadent criminals.

title: World of Illusion starring Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck
description: Guide amateur magicians Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck as they try to return home after being sucked into the mysterious World of Illusion by a powerful magician.

title: Final Fight
description: Final Fight is a classic beat-em-up game developed by Capcom featuring a memorable cast of characters, including Guy, Cody, and the first and only mustachioed ex-pro-wrestler turned mayor, Mike Haggar. Released for the CPS arcade system in 1989 and then ported to the SNES and other home systems.

title: Need for Speed: V-Rally 2
description: The sequel to V-Rally, V-Rally 2 is a rally racing game that was released in North America under both the Need for Speed (PlayStation) and Test Drive (Dreamcast) banners.

title: Sonic Adventure 2: Battle
description: Sonic and Shadow clash once more in this Dreamcast's swan song now ported to GameCube, featuring the same sprawling, fast-moving story told from both sides of the conflict. The multiplayer mode also returns, this time with the option to play as Amy Rose and Metal Sonic.

title: Wing Commander IV: The Price of Freedom
description: After dining on Kilrathi and scrambled eggs, Colonel Christopher Blair is recalled into active service to help defend the Confederation from a mysterious new enemy in this star-studded FMV space combat simulator from Origin.

title: Metal Slug: Super Vehicle - 001
description: Metal Slug is a 2D run-and-gun platformer for the Neo Geo that's known for its fluid animation, sense of humor, and brutal two-player action.

title: God of War
description: Play as the Spartan warrior, Kratos, as he cuts his way through armies of mythological creatures on a path to kill Ares, the God of War, and gain redemption for his past sins.

title: Landstalker: The Treasures of King Nole
description: As Treasure Hunter Nigel, journey to Mercator Island in search of the forgotten treasure of King Nole. Battle hordes of monsters, solve brain-bending riddles, and trek across the perilous island to uncover its secrets.

title: Driver
description: The original Driver is a classic driving game for the original Playstation.

title: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
description: A soccer game developed by Konami for the Sega Genesis, SNES and PS1 systems.

title: Kuru Kuru Kururin
description: A simple action puzzle game where the user controls a spinning stick through increasingly difficult to navigate mazes.

title: Tengai Makyou: Daiyon no Mokushiroku: The Apocalypse IV
description: A spin-off in the long running Tengai Makyou series that takes place in a fictionalized version America in the late 1800s.

title: Ranma 1/2: Hard Battle
description: The second SNES fighting game based on the comedic martial arts manga and anime series Ranma ½. Also known as the only game in the series to be localized intact for the U.S. and Europe.

title: Yakuza
description: Yakuza, known in Japan as Ryu ga Gotoku (Like a Dragon), is an open-world action-adventure game with RPG elements, developed and published by Sega, in which you play the role of a Yakuza gangster known as Kazuma Kiryu. It was released in 2005.

title: Dragon Quest V: Hand of the Heavenly Bride
description: Dragon Quest V is a turn-based RPG released in 1992 and is the fifth installment in the popular Dragon Quest series. It is also the second entry in the Zenithia Trilogy, and one of the most popular games in the franchise.

title: Fatal Frame III: The Tormented
description: A young woman whose fiance recently died finds herself in a ghostly manor when she falls asleep, only to be stalked by a woman's tattoo-covered spirit.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
description: Take control of real skaters and perform strings of crazy tricks in the first entry of the long-running Tony Hawk skateboarding series.

title: Super Monkey Ball
description: A puzzle game based on the challenge of moving a monkey inside of a ball around a course by the tilting of the course itself.

title: Arc the Lad
description: Arc The Lad is a SRPG and introduces recurring characters throughout the series.

title: Doom
description: In one of the most revolutionary first-person shooters of the 1990s, players control the last remaining space marine in the demon-infested stations on Mars' moons.

title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars
description: Join Mario in his first RPG adventure! Explore new and previously unseen areas of the Mushroom Kingdom on a quest to stop the mechanical Smithy on a path of conquest in this collaboration between Square and Nintendo.

title: Fear Effect
description: An action game that goes from Hong Kong to Hell, Fear Effect takes players to a dark world where killing people and monsters becomes part of the job as players search for a missing girl.

title: Parasite Eve II
description: This sequel to Square's "Cinematic RPG"  series has less cinema and more action, and is a truer survival horror experience.

title: Metal Slug 5
description: The Regular Army faces a new threat in the fifth sequential entry in the Metal Slug series.

title: Crash Bandicoot
description: Take control of Crash Bandicoot in his first adventure to stop the evil Doctor Neo Cortex and Nitrus Brio from taking over the world.

title: Super Mario Bros. 2
description: Mario and his friends find themselves in the mysterious world of Sub-Con, where they must fight new enemies (with new techniques) to stop the master plans of the evil toad king, Wart.

title: Star Wars: Jedi Knight - Dark Forces II
description: The followup to 1995's Dark Forces, Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II is a first-person shooter set within the Star Wars universe. Its story revolves around Kyle Katarn, who must discover his latent connection to the Force in order to combat seven powerful Sith Lords.

title: Bomberman: Party Edition
description: Bomberman: Party Edition was released for the Playstation more focused on the multiplayer side than single player.

title: Super Ghouls 'N Ghosts
description: The third game in the classic Ghosts 'n Goblins series sees the valiant knight Arthur once again embarking on a brutally difficult quest to rescue his beloved from demonic forces.

title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door
description: In his second papercraft adventure, Mario must find the seven Crystal Stars needed to open the mystical Thousand-Year Door (before a group of alien invaders do the same).

title: Saint Seiya: Ougon Densetsu
description: An RPG based on the famous Saint Seiya anime and manga. It was released in Japan on August 10th 1987 and later received a French translation due to Saint Seiya's popularity in France (as Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque).

title: Need for Speed: V-Rally
description: V-Rally is a rally racing game initially developed by Eden Studios for the PlayStation, published in North America by Electronic Arts under the title of Need for Speed: V-Rally. Later ported to PC, N64, Game Boy, and Game Boy Color.

title: Eternal Darkness: Sanity's Requiem
description: Eternal Darkness: Sanity's Requiem is an action-adventure game notable for its Lovecraftian horror, multiple playable characters from different time periods, and fourth-wall-breaking "sanity effects".

title: Alone in the Dark 3
description: The third and final installment in the original Alone in the Dark Trilogy once again involves Edward Carnby, travelling deep into Mojave desert to examine the disappearance of a film crew in an old ghost town.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 4
description: A football video game brought to you by Konami, Pro Evolution Soccer 4 features thousands of licensed players.

title: The Last Blade 2
description: The second and final chapter of the 19th-century Bakumatsu-era tale of swords and myths, adding some new warriors and techniques.

title: Magical Drop II
description: The sequel to Data East's entry into the tile-matching puzzle genre brings the fast-paced series to the Neo Geo, refining the art style and gameplay.

title: Street Fighter Collection
description: Collecting 3 classic Street Fighter games, this collection featured the American debut of Street Fighter Alpha 2 Gold.

title: Shenmue
description: An action-adventure game set in 1980s Japan that follows one young man's journey to avenge his father's murder. It was praised for its ambitious scope and pioneered several gameplay features such as realistic open-world environments and Quick Time Events.

title: Spyro the Dragon
description: Spyro the Dragon is a 3D platformer from acclaimed developers Insomniac Games. In this adventure, Spyro is tasked with freeing his fellow dragons from stone and defeating the evil Gnasty Gnorc.

title: Sonic Adventure
description: Sonic the Hedgehog and friends finally returned to the spotlight in this 1999 Dreamcast launch title.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Adventures
description: Create four-player mayhem to either vanquish the evil hordes of Vaati, or to blast each other into submission using the GBA link cable.

title: Bionic Commando
description: Bionic Commando follows hero Rad Spencer as he fights through enemy territory to rescue fellow commando, Super Joe.

title: Dead Head Fred
description: Dead Head Fred is an Action/Adventure game for the PSP, featuring an undead detective and his crazy head-swapping antics as he beats down mutants and embarks on a quest to save his town.

title: Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean
description: An RPG that uses a card-based battle system. You play the role as Guardian Spirit to Kalas and must help him and his friends save the island kingdom in the clouds which they live upon.

title: ISS Pro Evolution 2
description: The 2nd addition to the Pro Evolution Soccer franchise

title: Gran Turismo 2
description: Gran Turismo 2 is a realistic driving simulator for the PlayStation featuring over 600 vehicles.

title: The King of Fighters '96
description: The third installment in SNK's tag-team fighting game series, further revamping the gameplay while completely redrawing all characters in a newer style.

title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
description: The third installment of the Bust-A-Move series adds new gameplay changes and expands on the game's Versus Mode, adding numerous playable characters (each with their own unique attack pattern).

title: New Super Mario Bros.
description: Mario must use all of his abilities as well as several new power ups to rescue Princess Peach from the clutches of Bowser Junior in the first Super Mario Bros. game for the DS.

title: Final Fight 3
description: The last installment of the Fatal Fury beat-'em-up trilogy has Metro City under riot by a new threat, forcing Haggar and Guy to take action alongside two new allies.

title: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition
description: The sole 3D entry in SNK's Fatal Fury series of fighting games, loosely re-telling the story of the original Fatal Fury.

title: Super Metroid
description: Super Metroid is the third game in the Metroid series and the only Metroid game to be released on the Super Nintendo. It has become widely revered for its gameplay, atmosphere, and environmental storytelling, and continues to inspire many action-adventure games.

title: Shining Force III
description: The definitive strategy RPG on the Sega Saturn, spanning three separate games to form an epic trilogy, although the second and third games were never released outside of Japan.

title: EarthBound
description: A 1994 role-playing game starring a young boy named Ness on his quest to save the world. The game and its quirky humor have garnered a dedicated cult following among RPG fans.

title: Galaxy Force II
description: A space shooter where players must prevent the ruler of the Fourth Empire, Halcyon, from taking over the galaxy. The game is an updated version of Galaxy Force.

title: Vandal Hearts II
description: Vandal Hearts II is a tactical role-playing game released on the Sony Playstation. Instead of taking turns moving units, you and the computer move players simultaneously, leaving you thinking and predicting your opponents next move.

title: Mutation Nation
description: When a mysterious genetic virus mutates the inhabitants of a futuristic city, it's up to a pair of brawlers to stop its source before it infests the entire nation in this arcade beat-'em-up for Neo Geo hardware.

title: Resident Evil - Code: Veronica
description: Resident Evil: Code: Veronica is a survival horror video game initially developed and published by Capcom for the SEGA Dreamcast. It was later released for Sony PlayStation 2 and GameCube with improved graphics.

title: Super R-Type
description: Irem's Arcade hit shoot 'em up R-Type made its debut on the Super Nintendo Entertainment System as a launch title.

title: Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium
description: Capcom's final entry with their collaboration with SNK, adding a variety of new fighters and a six-button layout while completely revamping both the "Ratio" team building system and the "Groove" gameplay style system.

title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Legend
description: Lara travels across the world in search of a legendary artifact. Legend is the first entry in the 2006 reboot of the series and is the first Tomb Raider game developed by Crystal Dynamics after they took over the role from Core Design.

title: Formula 1
description: Formula 1 was the first F1 game on the Playstation and was developed by Bizarre Creations. It was released in 1996 but based on the 1995 F1 season.  It was officially licenced and included every car, driver and circuit that was present in 1995.

title: Xenosaga: Episode III - Also Sprach Zarathustra
description: The third and final episode of this Bandai Namco Japanese RPG series, released in 2006 for the PlayStation 2.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Clash of Super Heroes
description: Some of Capcom's greatest video game heroes are pitted against Marvel's finest superheroes in the third entry of the Marvel vs. Capcom crossover series.

title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back
description: An action platformer and the second game in the Crash Bandicoot franchise. Cortex is back and angrier than ever. Crash must jump, spin and slide his way to defeat Cortex yet again.

title: Exit
description: As Mr. ESC, a professional escapologist, you must save stranded people from natural disasters such as floods and fires in this stylish puzzler.

title: The Simpsons Wrestling
description: The Simpsons Wrestling lets you pick from your favorite Simpsons characters to battle against each other in the squared circle.

title: Tail Concerto
description: Tail Concerto is a 3D platformer that tells the story of Waffle, a dog police officer who is unwittingly tasked with getting to the bottom of the evil plans of a cat named Fool.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance
description: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance is an isometric turn-based strategy game for the Game Boy Advance.  You take on the role of a young boy on a mission to return everything to the way it was after a magical book and a wish transform the world.

title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
description: Set in the dark, brooding world of Nosgoth, Blood Omen tells a compelling tale about betrayal and vengeance.  It's also known for its horrendously long load times.

title: Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000
description: Capcom's initial entry into their crossover fighting game series with rival SNK, pitting fighters from the Street Fighter and King of Fighters series together in an all-out team-based brawl.

title: Brave Fencer Musashi
description: After being summoned to another world, the brash young swordsman Musashi embarks on a quest to save the peaceful Allucaneet Kingdom from the evil Thirstquencher Empire.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 2
description: The second in the "Budokai Tenkaichi" trilogy of Dragon Ball fighting games, adding dozens of new characters and transformations (for a total roster of 120).

title: Suikoden
description: Genso Suikoden, a Japanese RPG, was one of the first role-playing games released for the PlayStation console. The game puts you in the role of a young hero who finds himself leading an army of rebels trying to overthrow a corrupt empire. The game features over 108 recruitable characters.

title: Final Fantasy IX
description: Zidane Tribal and his troupe attempt to abduct Princess Garnet of Alexandria in this throwback to the classics of the series.

title: South Park
description: A comet is heading towards South Park, causing enemies such as mutant turkeys, killer cows, "Visitors", giant clones, living toys, and robots to flock to South Park. Cartman, Kyle, Stan, and Kenny must defeat these evil forces while trying to stop the comet from landing.

title: Art of Fighting 3: The Path of The Warrior
description: The final installment of SNK's Art of Fighting series brings a fresh new take to the series, streamlining the gameplay mechanics while adding cleaner sprites, smoother animation, and a brand new roster of challengers.

title: Rage Racer
description: Rage Racer is the third Ridge Racer installment on consoles and sports a unique, darker style compared to the rest of the series.

title: Super Mario 64 DS
description: A remake of the original Nintendo 64 classic, Super Mario 64 DS adds 30 new stars, three new playable characters and 36 mini-games utilizing the touch screen.

title: Final Fantasy X-2
description: Journey back to Spira two years later to rescue the missing Tidus in this first direct sequel to a Final Fantasy title.

title: Astérix
description: Released for the Sega Master System in 1991, Asterix is a 2D platformer.

title: Star Ocean
description: The first game in the Action RPG series. A human starship crashes into an alien planet and works with the natives to cure a deadly extra-terrestrial disease.

title: Escape from Monkey Island
description: The fourth Monkey Island game and the first to be in 3D. Escape tells the tale of Guybrush Threepwood's attempts to get Elaine reelected and defeat both LeChuck and his new ally, the evil Australian Ozzie Mandrill.

title: Syphon Filter: Logan's Shadow
description: The final Syphon Filter title, Logan's Shadow is the sequel to Syphon Filter: Dark Mirror, and introduces underwater combat to the series.

title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World
description: The most well known game out of the Alex Kidd series, Miracle World follows the adventures of the plucky little lad Alex as he fights his way through 16 stages to find his long lost brother. Sega's answer to Super Mario Bros, Miracle World is a more ambitious platformer, with more varied levels, quirky Roshambo battles, and a longer adventure.

title: Crazy Taxi
description: A high-octane taxicab driving game for arcades. Instead of racing other opponents, the cabbies must race the clock and dodge traffic to deliver their patrons to their destinations as fast as they can.

title: The Fifth Element
description: The Fifth Element is a game based on the 1997 sci-fi movie of the same name.  Players take turns playing Corben Dallas and Leeloo.

title: Breath of Fire IV
description: Take a journey with Ryu and Fou-lu as they fight against each other in a world torn by war and watched over by mysterious dragons called 'the Endless'.

title: The Lion King
description: The Lion King is a platformer released in 1994 for a wide array of systems by Virgin Interactive.

title: Parasite Eve
description: A strange mixing of survival horror and JRPG, Parasite Eve stars Aya Brea in her attempts to stop Mitochondria from destroying mankind.

title: Odin Sphere
description: A 2D fantasy action RPG which makes use of gorgeous sprite-based artwork. Odin Sphere was developed by Vanillaware and released for the PlayStation 2 by Atlus in 2007.

title: Animal Crossing: Wild World
description: Animal Crossing: Wild World is the Nintendo DS sequel to 2003's Animal Crossing, a life-style simulation game in which a human character fishes, catches bugs, and furnishes a house in a constantly-shifting neighborhood of animals.

title: Chrono Trigger
description: Take control of the lovable but silent protagonist Crono in this time-spanning collaborative effort from Squaresoft's "Dream Team." Chrono Trigger follows the exploits of Crono as he and his friends attempt to save the world from a planet-devouring alien creature.

title: Ecco the Dolphin
description: Take control of a dolphin and solve the mystery of a powerful storm in this unconventional and notoriously-difficult 2D side-scroller published by Sega.

title: Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga
description: Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga is an RPG for the Game Boy Advance featuring the famous brothers in an adventure to save both the Mushroom and Beanbean Kingdoms. The game is well-known for its comedy and colorful graphics.

title: Marvel Super Heroes Vs. Street Fighter
description: The second entry in the Marvel vs. Capcom crossover series, Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter pits fighters from Street Fighter Alpha 2 alongside fighters from Marvel Super Heroes.

title: LocoRoco
description: You must tilt, bounce, and roll your LocoRoco from one end of the level to the other.

title: QuackShot: Starring Donald Duck
description: A platforming adventure starring Disney's titular duck. Inspire by Indiana Jones, QuackShot has Donald, armed with a plunger gun, traveling the world in search of hidden treasure.

title: Resident Evil 2
description: Rookie cop Leon S. Kennedy and civilian Claire Redfield must make their way through a zombie-infested Raccoon City in the sequel to Capcom's original "survival horror" classic.

title: Mega Man X
description: The spiritual successor to the original Mega Man series of platformers, Mega Man X features a more technologically advanced hero and a darker storyline (set a century after the adventures of the original Mega Man).

title: Castle of Illusion starring Mickey Mouse
description: Minnie Mouse has been kidnapped by the evil witch Mizrabel, and it's up to Mickey Mouse to venture through the mysterious worlds of the Castle of Illusion to rescue her in this 2D platformer (and collaboration between Disney and Sega).

title: Disgaea: Afternoon of Darkness
description: Disgaea: Afternoon of Darkness is a port of the PS2 game Disgaea: Hour of Darkness.

title: Night Warriors: Darkstalkers' Revenge
description: The second installment of the Darkstalkers franchise refines both the original game's story (adding two new fighters) and gameplay (including an improved "super meter" system where characters can stock up on multiple meters and can perform enhanced moves at any time).

title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile
description: Join Klonoa and Huepow through a 2.5D adventure chasing the evil kidnappers, Ghadius and Joka.

title: Metal Gear Solid: The Twin Snakes
description: Remake of the acclaimed PlayStation stealth-action action title Metal Gear Solid, developed under supervision of creator Hideo Kojima and legendary Nintendo game designer Shigeru Miyamoto.

title: LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy
description: Be prepared to put those plastic, LEGO lightsabers to work as you rebel against the Galactic Empire in LucasArts' second installment of the LEGO Star Wars series.

title: ICO
description: The story of a forsaken boy with horns and a mysterious girl who must work together to escape from the confines of an enormous castle.

title: Dynasty Warriors
description: A traditional 3D fighting game and spin-off of Koei's Romance of the Three Kingdoms series, pitting heroes from each of the Three Kingdoms against each-other. It's best known for its large genre switch made standard for the game's numerous sequels.

title: WipEout
description: Pilots duke it out in a full 3D atmosphere to win in this futuristic, and now renowned, racing game set in the year 2052. Originally released in 1995.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Buyuu Retsuden
description: The sole Dragon Ball game released on a Sega platform, Buyuu Retsuden brings the high-flying combat from the Super Butoden series to the Mega Drive.

title: International Superstar Soccer 64
description: International Superstar Soccer 64 was the first game of the franchise to hit the Nintendo 64 in 1997.

title: Soulcalibur III
description: The tale of Soul Calibur continues in the series's fourth entry, adding a variety of new game modes and features (including an in-depth character creation system).

title: Dragon Ball: Advanced Adventure
description: Follow the adventures of kid martial artist Goku in this handheld side-scrolling adaptation of the original Dragon Ball series.

title: Super Princess Peach
description: Mario and friends are kidnapped and Princess Peach must rescue them.

title: Beyond the Beyond
description: Beyond the Beyond is a traditional role-playing game developed by Camelot for Sony's PlayStation. While it initially met with poor reviews and low sales, the game has gained a small cult following over the years.

title: Virtua Tennis: World Tour
description: Virtua Tennis: World Tour is Sega's first version of their popular Virtua Tennis franchise on the PSP.  It allows players to take create their own tennis superstars and guide them to the top of the rankings.

title: Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception
description: The first Ace Combat game released on the PSP, Skies of Deception introduces a new story and several new gameplay mechanics to the primarily console-based series.

title: Dark Cloud 2
description: Control Max, a young inventor, and Monica, a warrior princess from the future, as they fight their way through dungeons and train rides to save the world.

title: Pitfall!
description: Pitfall! has been holding it down as the grandfather of the modern day platformer since its release in 1982. The premise of the game is to avoid falling down pits.

title: Medal of Honor: Underground
description: A sequel to the original Medal of Honor, following a French Resistance fighter during World War 2.

title: Tekken
description: Namco's answer to Sega's Virtua Fighter, featuring a unique button system where each of the four buttons corresponds to attacks from each of the fighter's arms and legs.

title: Mario Kart 64
description: Mario Kart's first foray into 3D and the second game in the series, featuring an assortment of various power-ups and characters with a distinct Mario vibe.

title: Spider-Man and the X-Men: Arcade's Revenge
description: Spider-Man and the X-Men: Arcade's Revenge is an early 90s action game where a group of the strongest superheroes attempt to escape one of comicdom's weakest supervillains.

title: Suikoden II
description: Suikoden II is set three years after the events of Suikoden and tells the story of how young friends Riou and Jowy become caught up in the conflict between the Highland Empire and the City States of Jowston. Can you recruit all 108 Stars of Destiny and unite a nation?

title: Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire
description: Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire are the third set of Pokémon games in the franchise and were released in 2003.

title: Grandia II
description: Born of different worlds, woven together by fate, each shall rise to face their destiny.

title: Wonder Boy III: Monster Lair
description: The third game in Westone's Wonder Boy series and the last to debut in the Arcades, Wonder Boy III is best known outside of Japan as simply Monster Lair. Its sole US release was for the TurboGrafx-CD, though both it and the Genesis version were later added to the US Wii's Virtual Console line-up.

title: Tekken Tag Tournament
description: The fourth main installment of the Tekken franchise compiles nearly every character featured in the series' three previous games. It also adds a "tag team" mechanic for two-on-two battles.

title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
description: Resident Evil Director's Cut is a re-released version of the original title featuring new modes, music and items

title: Magical Drop III
description: The definitive installment of the Magical Drop series doubles the roster from the previous game while adding difficulty settings, a new single-player game mode, and dedicated attack patterns for all characters. It is also the last arcade game developed by Data East.

title: Resident Evil 0
description: Resident Evil Zero is a prequel to the long running Resident Evil series, being set merely a day before the Mansion Incident of the original Resident Evil. Zero has players simultaneously control two protagonists: STARS Bravo member Rebecca Chambers, and escaped convict Billy Coen.

title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Subsistence
description: An updated version of Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater containing several new features, most notably a third-person camera and an online mode.

title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
description: The third installment in the Zelda series makes a return to the top-down 2D gameplay of the original. Link must travel between the Light and Dark Worlds in order to set things right in the kingdom of Hyrule.

title: Bully
description: Rockstar swaps gangsters for delinquents in their open-world formula, giving players control of a new student at a rough-and-tumble private school.

title: Super Mario Bros. 3
description: Super Mario Bros. 3 sends Mario on a whole new adventure across diverse worlds and sporting strange new suits and abilities.

title: Metroid Fusion
description: Metroid Fusion is a sidescrolling 2D action-game for the Game Boy Advance. Chronologically, it is the furthest point in the Metroid timeline.

title: Yoshi's Island DS
description: Yoshi's Island comes to the DS in this sequel by Artoon.

title: Tekken 2
description: The sequel to Namco's original 3D fighting game adds new characters and a variety of new moves and unique attacks.

title: Soul of the Samurai
description: A samurai and a ninja team up to stop an evil warlord from raising a zombie army in this action game by Konami.

title: Conker's Bad Fur Day
description: A comedy platform adventure featuring Conker, a drunkard, foul-mouthed red squirrel trying to find his way home after he awakes hungover in the middle of a field with a fuzzy memory and only the clothes on his back to accompany him.

title: X-Men: Children of the Atom
description: The first fighting game set in the Marvel universe brings Capcom's take on the X-Men series, as the titular mutant superheroes must fight the mutant followers of Magneto.

title: The King of Fighters '98: The Slugfest
description: The fifth installment in SNK's tag-team fighting game series, bringing together most characters from the series' history in a non-canonical "Dream Match".

title: Mortal Kombat: Unchained
description: Mortal Kombat: Unchained is a port of Mortal Kombat: Deception for the PSP.

title: Arc the Lad II
description: The sequel to G-Craft's popular strategy-RPG introduces a new protagonist, Elc, who holds Arc responsible for the murder of his tribe.

title: Garou: Mark of the Wolves
description: The final game in the Fatal Fury franchise, Garou is set ten years after the death of Geese Howard, and features eleven brand new characters for the player to take control over.

title: Virtua Tennis
description: Virtua Tennis is the first game in Sega's arcade tennis franchise.

title: Silent Hill 2
description: James Sunderland tries to locate his wife in the eponymous town of Silent Hill in the first sequel to the 1999 PlayStation horror game. It is the first installment of the Silent Hill series on the PlayStation 2.

title: World Heroes Perfect
description: All of the competitors of the previous World Heroes tournaments come together for one final time-traveling contest to determine who is the strongest warrior in history.

title: Vagrant Story
description: Elite Riskbreaker Ashley Riot tracks the bloodstained trail of a mysterious cult leader through the mystical city of Lea Monde, in this cult classic action-tactical-RPG hybrid from Squaresoft.

title: Kingdom Hearts
description: A unique mix of Disney and Square Enix characters join spiky-haired hero Sora on his epic journey to save multiple worlds from the evil of the Heartless and find his lost friends Riku and Kairi.

title: Luigi's Mansion
description: Luigi's Mansion is a Gamecube launch title that features Luigi as the main character as opposed to his more famous sibling. In the game, Luigi must explore a mansion that he supposedly won in order to save his brother Mario.

title: Star Wars: Dark Forces
description: A 1995 first-person shooter by LucasArts, released for PCs and the PlayStation. It stars Imperial officer turned mercenary Kyle Katarn, who is hired by the Rebel Alliance to investigate and dismantle a secret Imperial weapons program.

title: Galerians
description: Galerians is a 1999 survival horror game, which follows a young boy called Rion who tries to remember who he is.

title: Earthworm Jim
description: Created by the twisted minds at Shiny Entertainment (led by Dave Perry and Doug TenNapel), Earthworm Jim is a nonsensical side-scrolling platform game that allows the player to venture through the galaxy as an earthworm trapped in a futuristic space-suit to rescue Princess What's-Her-Name.

title: X-Men vs. Street Fighter
description: The mutants of Marvel's X-Men and the martial artists of Capcom's Street Fighter collide in Capcom's first crossover fighting game.

title: Tekken 3
description: Set nearly twenty years after the events of its predecessor, the third Tekken features an overhauled roster and reworked 3D movement system, and the console version adds new characters and minigames.

title: FIFA 98: Road to World Cup
description: FIFA 98: Road to World Cup is a multiplatform instalment of the popular soccer video game series, allowing players to relive moments from the 1998 FIFA World Cup.

title: Runaway 2: The Dream of the Turtle
description: Runaway 2: The Dream of the Turtle is a point and click adventure game, released for the PC, Wii and Nintendo DS.

title: Final Fantasy X
description: The first Final Fantasy game for the PlayStation 2 brought cinematic quality to the series with voice acting and fully 3D environments. The story follows Tidus, a young man transported one thousand years into the future to find a world quite unlike his own.

title: Track & Field II
description: Run, hurdle, dive, swim, shoot, hop, skip and jump to a gold medal in this seminal Olympic games-style effort from Konami. In Japan, the game was released to tie in with the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul.

title: God of War II
description: God of War II continues the story of Kratos as he wields his newly-bestowed god-like powers, much to the dismay and fear of the other gods.

title: Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow
