description: The first Castlevania game for the Nintendo DS, continuing the tale of Soma Cruz and his ability to absorb the souls of fallen enemies for use in combat and utility.

title: Dragon Force
description: Play as one of the eight kingdoms of Legendra as they try to expand their territory and stop the rise of the evil Madruk. Players control the many generals of their kingdom both on a strategic world map and in real time battles.

title: Fatal Fury 2
description: The hot-blooded sequel to the original Fatal Fury, heavily improving the fighting mechanics of the original while adding a bigger cast of playable characters and worldwide locales.

title: Super Castlevania IV
description: An enhanced recreation of the original Castlevania, retelling Simon Belmont's crusade against Dracula with new levels, content, and gameplay elements.

title: Final Fantasy XII
description: The last Final Fantasy game released on the PS2, Final Fantasy XII is distinguished by its condition-driven "gambit" battle system, its Monster Hunter-like open environments and side quests, and its setting in the existing fictional universe of Ivalice.

title: Windjammers
description: Two athletes are pitted against each other in a grueling battle of special abilities, mind games, and throwing discs. It will blow you away.

title: Pokémon Emerald
description: Pokemon Emerald is set in the land of Hoenn and is the remix of Ruby/Sapphire.

title: Valkyrie Profile
description: The story of Lenneth, a Valkyrie charged with recruiting the souls of the fallen to fight in Ragnarok.

title: Tekken: Dark Resurrection
description: An enhanced version of the fifth main installment of the Tekken franchise, Dark Resurrection adds three new fighters and unlocks all fighters from the start. It is the first in the series to receive online multiplayer support (as an update to the PS3 port).

title: Half-Life: Counter-Strike
description: Originally created as a modification of the original Half-Life, Counter-Strike has since become its own franchise, setting new standards in online team-based shooters, and was at one point the single most-played online game in the world with a huge competitive following.

title: Nuclear Strike
description: The STRIKE Team goes after a rogue CIA Agent, who's prepared to unleash a nuclear attack on the world using stolen nuclear weapons.

title: The Granstream Saga
description: The Granstream Saga is an action RPG released for the PlayStation in 1997 and is the final game developed by Quintet. It was one of the first RPGs with fully 3D polygon graphics and featured third-person real-time combat. The plot, set on floating continents, utilized anime cutscenes.

title: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
description: Set years before the World Warrior tournament of Street Fighter II, Street Fighter Alpha explores the backstories of some of the series's familiar faces (while introducing new ones) with a revamped fighting game engine (complete with a new cartoony art style).

title: Guilty Gear
description: A 2D fighting game by Arc System Works for the PS1, featuring anime-style graphics and themes, a heavy metal soundtrack, and a distinct fast-paced gameplay system.

title: Castlevania II: Simon's Quest
description: Simon Belmont must rid himself of a horrible curse placed upon him by Dracula in this action-adventure platformer and sequel to the original Castlevania.

title: Soulcalibur II
description: The third main entry in the Soul series, Soulcalibur II is best known for its release on all three major consoles at the time, each of them featuring their own exclusive guest character.

title: Sam & Max Hit the Road
description: A tale about love, country-western music and bigfoots, Sam & Max Hit the Road is a point-and-click adventure game from LucasArts.

title: Super Soccer
description: Super Soccer is a soccer game developed by Human Entertainment and published by Nintendo for the SNES.

title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village
description: Professor Layton and the Curious Village is a point and click adventure puzzle game set in a charming village with enigmatic characters.  Solve over 120 puzzles given to you by the villagers to help you solve the mystery of the 'Golden Apple'.

title: Ghostbusters
description: Ghostbusters is based on the smash hit film of the same name. Players drive around New York catching ghosts and earning cash before heading to the Temple of Zuul.

title: Dino Crisis
description: Join Regina, as part of a special forces team sent to infiltrate a government facility, to discover the truth behind a scientific experiment that has drastically gone awry.

title: Advance Wars: Dual Strike
description: The first Advance Wars game for the Nintendo DS brings dual COs, battle modes and seven new units into the mix.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description: A young boy explores a huge overworld filled with enemies and dungeons to find and rescue Princess Zelda from the evil Ganon.

title: Relentless: Twinsen's Adventure
description: An isometric action-adventure dystopia from the creator of Alone in the Dark.

title: Wave Race 64
description: An early racing title for the Nintendo 64, combining challenging circuits and realistic water physics for a unique watercraft racing experience.

title: Elite Beat Agents
description: Elite Beat Agents is a rhythm game for the Nintendo DS developed by iNiS Corp. and published by Nintendo. It is a spiritual sequel to the Japanese only Osu! Tatakae! Ouendan, and uses many of the same touch screen based gameplay mechanics.

title: Super Bomberman
description: Super Bomberman was the first Bomberman game to appear on the SNES, and the first game on that system to feature 4 player simultaneous play via the multitap.

title: Evil Zone
description: A bizarre 3D fighting game with a heavy mishmash of anime tropes and a simplistic control scheme (with only ONE attack button).

title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow
description: The third Castlevania installment for the Game Boy Advance, bringing the tale of Castlevania to the 21st century and putting players in the shoes of Soma Cruz, a seemingly-normal guy who has the power to absorb souls of the castle's demons.

title: Eternal Eyes
description: Control the cute monsters to prevent the resurrection of the goddess of destruction in this turn based strategy RPG!

title: Ikaruga
description: A vertically scrolling shoot 'em up, from Treasure that features unique polarity-switching gameplay. It is the spiritual successor to Radiant Silvergun.

title: Final Fantasy VIII
description: In the eighth numbered Final Fantasy title, Squall and his band of mercenaries fight to save their world from conquest and destruction. It introduced several new concepts to the franchise, including a subplot with an alternate main character, level-scaling enemies, and the Junction system.

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
description: The follow-up to the 1998 blockbuster, Metal Gear Solid 2 blends tactical stealth and action. This sequel takes the action to an offshore oil cleanup facility seized by terrorists who are holding the President hostage. It helped sell the PS2, featuring advanced AI, physics and cover mechanics for its time, and one of the first postmodern narratives in gaming.

title: Soulcalibur
description: The sequel to Namco's earlier fighting game Soul Edge, continuing the story of the cursed blade "Soul Edge" (now corrupting the noble knight Siegfried into the dreaded knight Nightmare).

title: Street Fighter EX Plus Alpha
description: This first home version of Street Fighter EX is the third version of the original game, adding a couple of new characters.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: The first 3D Legend of Zelda game, Ocarina of Time was created for the Nintendo 64 in 1998 and introduced innovative mechanics such as Z-targeting as well as many of the series' other trademarks. It has frequently been ranked as the greatest game of all time by many publications.

title: Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood
description: The third installment of SNK's popular weapon-based fighting game series overhauls the roster, sprite style, and gameplay mechanics of the previous two games.

title: Advance Wars
description: A colorful turn-based strategy game developed by Intelligent Systems. It is the first game in Nintendo's "Wars" series to be released outside Japan.

title: World Cup 98
description: The official Fifa World Cup '98 game, including all 32 licensed international teams and all 10 stadiums.

title: International Superstar Soccer '98
description: ISS '98 was released before the start of FIFA World Cup in June 1998 as the second installment of the International Superstar Soccer series. It featured many new motion captured animations, additional camera angles, new teams and an extended player creation kit.

title: Animal Crossing
description: In Animal Crossing, the player lives a virtual life where they design interiors, collect items, capture various species of bugs and fish,  and explore a one-of-a-kind town filled with amiable animal townsfolk.

title: Shinobi Legions
description: The lone Sega Saturn entry in the Shinobi franchise, Shinobi Legions (also known as Shinobi X and Shin Shinobi Den) features digitized graphics and live-action cutscenes filled with ninjas.

title: Marvel Super Heroes
description: Marvel's most prolific heroes and villains duke it out for control of the Infinity Gems in Capcom's second fighting game in the Marvel universe.

title: Pokémon Colosseum
description: Pokemon Colosseum welcomes the player to a new desert Region called Orre to save the area and everyone in it from an evil group set out to take over the world with heartless Pokemon called Shadow Pokemon.

title: Gran Turismo 3 A-Spec
description: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec is a driving simulator released for the Playstation 2 which garnered critical acclaim upon its release in 2001.

title: Soccer
description: Soccer is the seminal soccer game for the NES, it is wholly about soccer.

title: Final Fantasy VII
description: The seventh numbered entry in the Final Fantasy franchise brings the series into 3D with a landmark title that set new industry standards for cinematic storytelling. Mercenary Cloud Strife joins the rebel group AVALANCHE in their fight against the power-hungry Shinra Company, but their struggle soon becomes a race to save the entire Planet from an impending cataclysm.

title: Devil May Cry
description: Play as Dante, son of the legendary dark knight Sparda, as he takes on the emperor of the demon world, Mundus. With help from the lovely Trish, the Force Edge and his guns, Ebony and Ivory.

title: Fire Emblem: Thracia 776
description: The fifth game in the Fire Emblem series, released only in Japan for the Super Famicom. It is a midquel to Fire Emblem: Seisen no Keifu and stars Leif, a major character from the previous game.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3
description: The third game in the original Budokai trilogy of fighting games set in the Dragon Ball universe. Along with numerous gameplay changes, it features characters and settings from both Dragon Ball GT and some of the series' animated films.

title: Hyper V-Ball
description: Hyper V-Ball is a volleyball game for the Super Nintendo. It was developed by Video System.

title: Yakuza 2
description: Yakuza 2 is a free-roaming action-adventure brawler which is a continuation of the original Yakuza game on the PlayStation 2. The game is set 1 year after the first game in Osaka,  Japan and follows the exploits of Kiryu Kazuma as he tries to settle a gang war.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 2008
description: The seventh rendition of the popular, long running soccer simulator Pro Evolution Soccer. The game is available on PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Wii, Nintendo DS, Xbox 360, and PC.

title: The Legend of Dragoon
description: A young man sets out on a quest to save his childhood friend who has been kidnapped and locked in a prison. What he doesn't know is that the journey that lies ahead of him and the significance of his Father's red stone that was left behind.

title: Mr. Bones
description: In Mr. Bones players take control of an undead blues musician who must destroy the evil vampire who brought him back to life.

title: Grim Fandango
description: A LucasArts adventure game that follows skeletal travel agent Manny Calavera's four-year journey across the Land of the Dead in a film-noir-inspired tale of love, betrayal and corruption.

title: Art of Fighting 2
description: The direct sequel to the original Art of Fighting, adding a more traditional single-player mode (where any character can be chosen) and an improved character roster.

title: Wii Sports
description: Compete with friends in simplified motion controlled versions of five sports: tennis, baseball, bowling, golf, and boxing. It served as the pack-in game for most distributions of the Wii, making it the best-selling single-platform game of all time.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Justice For All
description: The second game in the Ace Attorney franchise, you reprise your role as Phoenix Wright and take on new cases meeting characters new and old.

title: The King of Fighters: Evolution
description: The Dreamcast version of King of Fighters '99.

title: Real Bout Fatal Fury Special
description: The sixth installment of SNK's Fatal Fury series, bringing back the multi-line fighting system of earlier Fatal Fury games while removing the "ring out" mechanic of the original Real Bout and adding four characters from Fatal Fury Special.

title: Alone in the Dark 2
description: Alone in the Dark 2 is the sequel to Alone in the Dark and features the same mixture of cinematic action sequences as well as minor puzzle solving. The game is part of the original Alone in the Dark trilogy as developed by Infogrames Entertainment

title: Phantasy Star IV: The End of the Millennium
description: As bounty hunter Chaz you'll lead a group of adventurers to save your home planet of Motavia and eventually the whole solar system in this acclaimed RPG from Sega. The final game in the Phantasy Star series' canon.

title: Burnout 2: Point of Impact
description: The second installment of Criterion's Burnout series of street racing games, building on the high-octane racing while including a new puzzle mode where players stage spectacular car crashes.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
description: The follow-up to Ocarina of Time sees the series stalwart Link embark on a journey to save the land of Termina from being crushed by the moon in three days. To defeat the Skull Kid, Link has to live the same three days over and over again.

title: WarioWare: Smooth Moves
description: Smooth Moves is the fifth WarioWare game, continuing the franchise tradition of packing dozens of microgames into a single package.

title: Gargoyle's Quest
description: A 1990 action RPG developed by Capcom for the Nintendo Game Boy and a spin-off of their Ghosts N' Goblins series. It was notable for its well-developed real-time platformer combat, and for being one of the more technically accomplished Game Boy titles of its time.

title: Last Resort
description: A sci-fi side-scrolling shoot-'em-up by SNK, drawing heavy inspiration fron the R-Type series with its use of a large satellite component guarding the ship.

title: ChuChu Rocket!
description: A puzzle game from Sonic Team, ChuChu Rocket! was one of the first games to include online multiplayer on a console.

title: R-Type
description: A 2D side-scrolling shooter, and an arcade classic! Travel across space, power-up the companion orb, and bring down some of the toughest alien bosses in gaming.

title: This is Football
description: This Is Football played a good game of footy on the Playstation. It took on EA's mammoth with some style and flair.

title: SimCity 2000
description: SimCity 2000 is a city simulation game where players can build cities from small and neat to large and dirty, or anything in between.

title: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare
description: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare is a survival horror game developed by Darkworks studios and published by Infogrames. The game takes place on 'Shadow Island', and features two main protagonists: Aline Cedrac and Edward Carnby.

title: Monster Hunter Freedom
description: Considered the definitive first generation Monster Hunter game, Monster Hunter Freedom compiles all the content included in Monster Hunter G and brings it to the PSP while adding new quality of life features and content.

title: Mega Man 2
description: The evil Dr. Wily is back with eight new menacing creations, and it's up to Mega Man to foil his new plans for world domination! Known for bootstrapping the long-running series, the game also introduces passwords, helpful items (such as Energy Tanks), and the series standard of eight bosses.

title: Hokuto no Ken 6: Gekitou Denshouken Haou e no Michi
description: A fighting game based on the Fist of the North Star franchise.

title: Patapon
description: Patapon is a mix of the Rhythm genre and Real Time Strategy genre in which you lead a tribe of warriors by the beat of your drums, on the search for the legendary “IT”.

title: Tales of the Abyss
description: Tales of the Abyss is the eighth main game in the Tales of franchise, telling the story of Luke fon Fabre and his quest to save the world from the sinister Oracle Knights.

title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
description: Dracula's castle has risen from the mist and the Belmont heir is missing! The open-ended gameplay mixed with RPG mechanics in this installment of Castlevania platformers set the template for later games in the series (coining the term "Metroidvania").

title: Bust-A-Move
description: Also known as Puzzle Bobble, Bust-A-Move is a puzzle spinoff of Bubble Bobble where players try to clear a board of colored bubbles by firing other bubbles at an angle.

title: Shining Soul II
description: A lengthy fantasy action RPG with plenty of features.

title: Golden Axe
description: A classic, side-scrolling hack and slash game, Golden Axe was ported to many platforms, including the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive.

title: Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin
description: The second Castlevania entry for the Nintendo DS, extending the story of the 20th century heirs to the Vampire Killer whip (the Morris family).

title: Silent Hill: 0rigins
description: Enter Silent Hill for the first time, as redneck trucker Travis Grady explores the haunted town and discovers how true evil began.

title: SaGa Frontier
description: The first PlayStation entry in the SaGa series, Frontier offers seven unique stories to play through, each starring a different protagonist.

title: Vanguard Bandits
description: Vanguard bandits is a turn based "mech" style combat game set in a fantasy world. The ending depends on your choices.

title: Super Mario Land 2: 6 Golden Coins
description: Mario's second platforming adventure on Game Boy introduces the evil Wario, who has taken over Mario's castle in his absence. Mario must gather the six golden coins scattered throughout Mario Land to reopen the castle gates and defeat his twisted counterpart.

title: Pokémon FireRed/LeafGreen
description: Return to Kanto filled with a whole new chapter to the game. With a brand new features and new ways to capture Pokemon, it time for whole new revolution.

title: Star Wars: Jedi Knight II - Jedi Outcast
description: After severing his connection with the Force and returning to his mercenary ways, an unexpected encounter forces Kyle Katarn to re-establish his path as a Jedi Knight.

title: Shining Force II
description: The demon lord Zeon has been set free by an unwitting thief. It is the job of Bowie, a young hero from the Kingdom of Granseal, to lead the Shining Force to victory in this Tactical RPG from Sega.

title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
description: An action-adventure adaptation of the first film in the Star Wars prequel trilogy, detailing the exploits of Jedis Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi during the invasion of Naboo.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Portable Ops
description: A Metal Gear Solid game for the PSP which uses similar stealth gameplay found in the popular Playstation and Playstation 2 titles.

title: Daxter
description: Follow Daxter, Jak's wise cracking and often obnoxious sidekick, as he tries to free Jak following his capture by Baron Praxis after their arrival in Haven City.

title: Final Fight 2
description: Straight-to-console sequel to the original Final Fight takes Mike Haggar worldwide as he and two new allies take on a re-grouped Mad Gear gang.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
description: Take on the role of Jak, and embark on a long journey to change Daxter back from his ottsel form.

title: Tekken 4
description: The fourth main installment in the Tekken series, bringing the game engine to the PS2 era and experimenting with a variety of new gameplay mechanics (such as closed arenas, where players can use walls and other obstacles for consecutive combos).

title: Threads of Fate
description: Lost between the Summer of Adventure promotion Squaresoft ran in the summer of 2000, which included Legend of Mana and the behemoth Chrono Cross, this game became a cult classic.

title: WipEout Pure
description: Wipeout Pure is the seventh game in the Wipeout series and the first game in the franchise on a portable system.

title: Real Bout Fatal Fury 2: The Newcomers
description: The last game in the classic Fatal Fury series, Real Bout 2 adds two new characters while adding another set of changes to the game's core mechanics. GET IN THE RING!!!

title: Tennis 2K2
description: Arcade tennis game known as Virtua Tennis 2 in Europe.

title: Fighting Force
description: Fighting Force is a beat-'em-up released in 1997 for the PlayStation.

title: SimCity
description: The first installment in the highly acclaimed SimCity franchise by Maxis' Will Wright. The gameplay centers around developing and managing a city in a variety of scenarios using a combination of different zones and buildings.

title: Bahamut Lagoon
description: A tactical turn-based strategy game with battles on a grid-based map. Once two units meet in battle, the combat system follows the familiar turn-based structure.

title: Tobal 2
description: The sequel to Tobal No. 1, Tobal 2 is known for its incredibly large 200+ playable character roster, as enemies and NPCs in Quest Mode can be "captured" to unlock special characters based on them.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 2
description: The second game in the Budokai sub-series of fighting games based on the Dragon Ball manga and animated series adds a new single-player campaign (similar to board games) and the rest of the Dragon Ball Z story arc.

title: F-Zero
description: Nintendo's flagship futuristic racing game featuring the raw new power of "Mode 7" technology, which gives players the illusion of dangerous high-speed racing at over 200 mph!

title: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus
description: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus is a platformer that sees Sly Cooper and his gang on a mission to defeat the five criminals that killed Sly's family and reclaim the pages of the Thievius Raccoonus, a book of family thieving techniques compiled by generations of the Cooper family.

title: Mario Power Tennis
description: Mario Power Tennis is a casual tennis game for the GameCube.  It introduced power shots to the Mario Tennis franchise.

title: Rival Schools: United by Fate
description: When several students and staff of fictional Japanese high schools are either missing or attacked, several students set out to investigate the cause.

title: Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time
description: Partners in Time is the second in the Mario & Luigi series. In this game, Mario, Luigi, Baby Mario, and Baby Luigi travel back and forth through time to save the Mushroom Kingdom. It features a battle engine similar to that of Paper Mario.

title: Metroid Prime
description: Take control of Samus Aran in her first 3D adventure as she battles the Space Pirates on Tallon IV while uncovering the mysterious disappearance of its inhabitants.

title: Super Mario Bros.
description: Focusing on a humble plumber and his brother setting out to rescue a Princess who has been kidnapped by a vile lizard king, Super Mario Bros. is a platformer created by Shigeru Miyamoto, published by Nintendo, and is one of the best-selling video games of all time.

title: Virtua Fighter
description: Best known as the first fighting game to render player characters using 3D polygons, Virtua Fighter pits eight martial artists (each with numerous real-world fighting techniques) from around the world together in the World Fighting Tournament.

title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles
description: An action-adventure RPG for the GameCube and the first Final Fantasy since VI to be released on a Nintendo Console, Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles allows four-player co-op using the Gameboy Advance to GameCube link cables.

title: The King of Fighters 2000
description: The seventh installment of SNK's King of Fighters series and the last game they developed before their bankruptcy. It features an expansion of the "Striker" system, including numerous Striker-only characters for additional options.

title: Donkey Kong Country
description: For the first time in Nintendo history, take control of Mario's former adversary as he travels through the island (with his nephew Diddy Kong) to recover his stolen banana hoard in this side-scrolling platformer from Rare (now Rareware).

title: Mortal Kombat
description: By combining digitized character graphics and extreme violence, Midway's 1992 fighter revolutionized the U.S. fighting game genre, spawned a long-running series, and helped create controversy regarding video game violence.

title: Anna Kournikova's Smash Court Tennis
description: Anna Kournikova's Smash Court Tennis is the sequel to the original PS1 game, takes a more casual approach to the sport, with characters from other popular games and some wild courts!

title: DuckTales
description: The world's richest duck sets off on a globe-trotting adventure to uncover several lost treasures with the help of his family and friends. Explore five exotic locations across the world and pogo-jump to victory as Scrooge McDuck in this NES classic.

title: Beyond Good & Evil
description: The story of a young, curious, and green-loving photojournalist named Jade, out to unravel an alien conspiracy on her home planet of Hillys.

title: Time Crisis
description: An early 3D-polygonal light-gun shooter from Namco, pitting one-man army Richard Miller against a ruthless terrorist organization in a remote island.

title: Viewtiful Joe
description: Take the role of Viewtiful Joe, and save your girlfriend Silvia from the horrible dangers of Movieland.

title: Mafia
description: Mafia is a sandbox style, third-person action game set in the fictional city of Lost Heaven. The player assumes the role of Tommy Angelo as he rises through the ranks of the Mafia in Depression-era America. The game was developed by Czech developer Illusion Softworks.

title: Kirby's Adventure
description: Kirby's sole NES adventure introduces his signature ability to copy the abilities of special enemies (by swallowing them), as he must retrieve the seven broken Star Rod pieces to restore everyones' dreams.

title: Legend of Mana
description: Unlock sidequests and save the world in Square's follow up to Secret of Mana.

title: Wild Arms 2
description: Wild ARMS 2 is a steampunk JRPG that tells the story of the anti-terrorist group "Agile Remote Mission Squad" defending the world of Filgaia from the terrorist cell "Odessa."

title: Forbidden Siren 2
description: Sequel to Forbidden Siren. Released in 2006.

title: Batman: The Movie
description: This game is based on the 1989 Batman movie starring Michael Keaton.  During the course of the game, you will play through certain sections of the movie before your final confrontation with The Joker.

title: World Heroes 2 JET
description: A new heavily-publicized martial arts tournament, known as the World Heroes Battle Fest, is taking place in modern times. Who among history's greatest warriors will prevail in this third entry to the World Heroes series? Athlete admitted!

title: Super Mario Galaxy
description: In Mario's first Wii adventure, the famed plumber travels throughout the universe on his latest quest to save Princess Peach from the evil Bowser.

title: Metal Gear Solid
description: Metal Gear Solid, released in 1998, is a game developed and published by Konami Corporation. The game follows recent retiree Solid Snake in his return to active duty as he attempts to rescue DARPA Chief Donald Anderson and President of ArmsTech Kenneth Baker, both taken hostage by a terrorist group, in order to prevent the terrorists from launching a nuclear warhead.

title: Skies of Arcadia: Legends
description: Take to the skies as Vyse and his fellow Blue Rogues as they battle a powerful Empire and an ancient evil to save the world in this enhanced Gamecube port of Overworks' Dreamcast RPG.

title: Shiritsu Justice Gakuen: Nekketsu Seishun Nikki 2
description: Shiritsu Justice Gakuen: Nekketsu Seishun Nikki 2  is a sequel that expands only slightly on the first Rival Schools.

title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
description: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link is the second entry in the ground-breaking Zelda franchise. This controversial follow-up ditches the original's top-down perspective for 2D side-scrolling exploration and combat. The 2D towns, dungeons and combat arenas are tied together by a top-down overworld.

title: Mega Man Powered Up
description: An enhanced remake of the old NES title, Mega Man Powered Up delivers a new twist to an old title.

title: Samurai Shodown II
description: The second entry in SNK's historical-fantasy fighting game series adds a variety of new fearsome warriors, advanced techniques (such as rolling, ducking, and hopping), and deadly special moves (including powerful ones used specifically with the Rage Meter).

title: Burning Fight
description: SNK's answer to the crime-themed beat 'em up genre pits three police detectives against an army of international criminals in modern-day Japan.

title: Dune
description: Dune is a first person adventure strategy game. The player sees the world through the eyes of Paul Atreides and is given the tasks to manage spice extraction and build up military force.

title: Legend of Legaia
description: Legend of Legaia is a Japanese role-playing game for the PlayStation that follows the story of Vahn, a young man out to rid the world of a deadly mist.

title: Devil May Cry 2
description: Devil May Cry 2 is the sequel to the 2001 critically-acclaimed Devil May Cry from Capcom. The game follows returning protagonist Dante and new playable character Lucia as they hack and slash their way through hordes of demons. Fans consider this to be the weakest in the series.

title: Mario Kart: Super Circuit
description: Race against your favorite Mario characters on tracks resembling locations in the Mario universe. Use a wide array of power-ups and weapons to gain the upper hand and become the kart racing champion.

title: The Simpsons: Bart vs. the Space Mutants
description: Bart starts a journey to stop aliens' evil plans and save the world using mostly slingshots and spray cans.

title: Castlevania: The Dracula X Chronicles
description: Dracula is still a threat in this updated version of Castlevania: Rondo of Blood, remade with 3D graphics for the Playstation Portable. Also included on the disc is the original PC-Engine Super CD-ROM2 version of Rondo of Blood as well as the sequel, Symphony of the Night.

title: Mickey Mania
description: A side-scrolling platformer featuring Disney mascot Mickey Mouse that is inspired by his long history in animated films.

title: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest
description: When Donkey Kong is kong-napped by the evil Kaptain K. Rool, it's up to nephew Diddy (and his girlfriend Dixie) to traverse Crocodile Isle to rescue him!

title: Shining the Holy Ark
description: Shining the Holy Ark is a traditional turn based RPG within the 'Shining' series of games, which was released on the Sega Saturn.

title: Tactics Ogre: Let Us Cling Together
description: Tactics Ogre: Let Us Cling Together is the second game in the Ogre Battle Series.

title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix
description: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix is a prequel to the original Fear Effect for the Playstation console. The game's story reveals the conditions under which the three protagonists from the first game met each other, and the events that preceded the story of the original Fear Effect.

title: Ghosts 'N Goblins
description: Ghosts 'N Goblins is the first game in the Ghosts 'N Goblins series. It is widely recognized as being one of the hardest games of all time.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
description: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is the second 3D game in the series and sixth original title. It features more of the same sand-box action-adventure gameplay with a new 1980s setting, new characters, new weapons and much more.

title: Nintendo World Cup
description: Bicycle kick power shots, murderous shoulder slams, unconscious defenders, and soccer on ice... this is what happens when Kunio-kun and crew take to the soccer pitch.

title: Disney's Hercules: Action Game
description: Disney's Hercules is a movie based action game for the PlayStation and PC. In it, the player takes control of Hercules, who must complete various feats in order to be admitted into Olympus and sit alongside the gods.

title: Brigandine: The Legend of Forsena
description: Brigandine is a strategy RPG where you take control of one of six different nations, all vying to conquer the continent. With a wide assortment of unique Rune Knights and a plethora of monster armies, your goal is to control the continent of Forsena, one castle at a time.

title: Metroid: Zero Mission
description: A GBA Metroid game and remake of the original Metroid for the NES. It also depicts what happens immediately after the self destruct sequence by Mother Brain.

title: The Sims
description: Construct and furnish a home, and then influence the day-to-day lives of its occupants (called Sims) in an isometrical "people simulator" by Will Wright.

title: Out of This World
description: A critically acclaimed "cinematic platformer" in which players control an unassuming young scientist trapped on an alien planet.

title: Jade Cocoon: Story of the Tamamayu
description: Jade Cocoon is a fantasy turn-based RPG, seen by some as a cross of Final Fantasy and Pokemon.

title: Deus Ex
description: A celebrated cyberpunk-themed first-person role-playing game, Deus Ex puts players behind the shades of JC Denton--an operative thrust into a world of byzantine global conspiracies.

title: Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars
description: The first game in the Broken Sword franchise -- also known as Circle of Blood -- is a point and click adventure game. A Director's Cut with new content has been released on the Wii, DS and iPhone.

title: Front Mission 3
description: A turn-based tactics RPG, set in the near future where giant mecha fight alongside or against tanks and troops.

title: Grandia
description: A JRPG that tells the story of the young adventurer named Justin who tries to uncover the reason why the ancient civilization of Angelou disappeared.

title: Monster Rancher
description: Monster Rancher is a monster simulation game where creatures are generated by inserting CDs into the console.

title: The Last Blade
description: SNK's spiritual successor to their Samurai Shodown series, taking place during mid-19th century Japan.

title: Super Smash Bros. Melee
description: The second in the Super Smash Bros. series brings the four-player brawling action to the GameCube, significantly expanding the roster and single-player content while refining gameplay.

title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete
description: A young boy and his friends must embark on an epic journey of friendship and love across the planet of Lunar.

title: Gran Turismo 4
description: Gran Turismo 4 is the 4th instalment in the PlayStation-exclusive driving simulation series.

title: Ys Origin
description: Ys Origin is the first chronological Ys game and is the only entry in series where the main character is not Adol Christin.

title: Fire Emblem: Seisen no Keifu
description: The fourth game in the Fire Emblem series, released only in Japan for the Super Famicom. It presents a storyline spanning two generations and is one of the darkest entries in the franchise.

title: Kartia: The Word of Fate
description: Kartia: The Word of Fate

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Turtles in Time
description: Shred your way through Shredder's minions and other iconic TMNT villains as any of the four turtles in this classic beat 'em up.

title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater
description: The third installment in the Metal Gear Solid franchise is swathed in the Cold War, and it's up to a strangely familiar soldier codenamed Naked Snake to keep the Soviet Union and the United States from all-out nuclear war.

title: Sonic & Knuckles
description: Play as Sonic or Knuckles as the power of the floating island's Master Emerald is revealed in this concluding sequel to Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (now featuring a unique lock-on technology, granting special features when "locked on" to certain other games).

title: Streets of Rage 2
description: Mr. X and his powerful criminal syndicate have returned to the streets. Players take control of up to two of the four vigilantes, fighting their way through the hordes of punks once again, in one of the most acclaimed beat 'em up brawlers of all time.

title: Choplifter!
description: Originally developed by Dan Gorlin of Brøderbund, Choplifter!, which claims to be the computer! game of the year, focuses on the simple mechanics of avoiding fire while ferrying hostages from their capture bunkers to a home base.

title: Trauma Center: Under the Knife
description: Using only your stylus, you must perform emergency operations in a race against the clock in this hospital operating room "simulator"... anime style!

title: Track & Field
description: Players button mash their way through Olympic events in this arcade and console classic

title: Phantasy Star III: Generations of Doom
description: The third instalment in the Phantasy Star series of RPGs. An epic adventure featuring three generations of characters, PSIII had a slower pace and unique setting that made it the "black sheep" of the series.

title: Last Bronx
description: A 3D fighting game from the studio behind Virtual On, putting players in control of a weapon-clad gang leader as they fight to determine the strongest gang in Tokyo.

title: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja 2
description: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja 2 is the second game in the Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Franchise. Adding More Characters and stages as well as a more refined combat system.

title: Xenogears
description: Xenogears is an RPG spanning several millennia, weaving religion and philosophy with science fiction and turn based gameplay.

title: Ratchet & Clank
description: Ratchet & Clank is a platformer adventure game that follows two heroes, Ratchet and Clank, on their journey to save Ratchet's home planet.

title: PaRappa the Rapper
description: Parappa the Rapper is a hip-hop themed rhythm game for the Playstation and PSP starring a rapping dog and his adventures to impress his secret crush.

title: Rayman
description: Rayman marks the debut for the Ubisoft series of the same name.

title: Killer Instinct
description: Rare's signature fighting game, featuring heavy use of pre-rendered 3D graphics, a unique match format, a special multi-sequence combo system, and C-C-C-COMBO BREAKER

title: SaGa Frontier 2
description: Sequel to the non-linear Playstation RPG, SaGa Frontier. SaGa Frontier and SaGa Frontier II are part of the SaGa Franchise, which enjoys more popularity in Japan and originated with SaGa on the Gameboy.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
description: The first entry in the Zelda franchise for the GameCube, sporting a distinctive cel-shaded graphics style. It built upon the mechanics of Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, and its oceanic setting emphasized exploration.

title: Metal Slug 6
description: Sixth installment of the Metal Slug franchise and the first to leave the Neo-Geo hardware. Introduces two new characters from the Ikari Warriors/King of Fighters franchises.

title: Super Mario All-Stars
description: Mario's 8-bit adventures were compiled and enhanced for the Super Nintendo on a single cartridge. This was the international debut of "The Lost Levels", originally sold as Super Mario Bros. 2 only in Japan.

title: Disgaea: Hour of Darkness
description: Disgaea: Hour of Darkness is a tactical role-playing game for the PlayStation 2, which focuses on the story of Prince Laharl as he aims to become the Overlord of the Netherworld.

title: World Heroes
description: Many of history's greatest warriors, from Genghis Khan to Hulk Hogan, participate in a time-traveling martial arts tournament to determine who is the strongest!

title: The King of Fighters '95
description: The second installment in SNK's tag-team fighting game series, introducing the ability for players to customize their own three-fighter team from the overall roster.

title: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout
description: Characters from various points in both Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball GT collide. Also known as the first Dragon Ball game to have an official North American release with the license intact.

title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
description: Taking place in the Old Republic era of Star Wars, around 4000 years before the events of the films, Knights of the Old Republic is a third-person turn-based RPG where players travel the galaxy as a mysterious Republic soldier, racing against time to thwart a massive Sith fleet.

title: Tekken 5
description: Namco's signature martial arts fighting game series gets a fifth main installment that continues the story of Jin Kazama and the Mishima Zaibatsu. It's known for introducing persistent player rankings and appearance customization options (requiring use of a dedicated card reader in the arcade version).

title: Mario Kart: Double Dash!!
description: Mario Kart: Double Dash!! is the fourth installment in the Mario Kart series, following Mario Kart: Super Circuit from 2001. The game introduced a number of new gameplay features, most notably the inclusion of two riders per kart.

title: NHL 98
description: The 7th game of the NHL franchise from EA Sports. It was the last to be released on 16-bit systems.

title: Alex Ferguson's Player Manager 2001
description: Become like the greatest manager in English football and possibly the world.

title: Star Fox Adventures
description: Rare's last game for a major Nintendo console, Star Fox Adventures is an action-adventure game set in the Star Fox universe. Take control of ace pilot Fox McCloud as he searches for a way to save the aptly-named Dinosaur Planet from destruction.

title: Top Spin
description: Top Spin is a realistic tennis simulator available for the Xbox, Playstation 2, and the PC.

title: Fighters Megamix
description: The SEGA-AM2 team throws together the cast of both Virtua Fighter 2 and Fighting Vipers, along with a plethora of weird and wonderful Sega characters, for a massive 3D brawl.

title: Super Mario Kart
description: The first installment in the long-running Mario Kart franchise features eight iconic characters from the Mario universe.

title: Street Fighter Alpha 2
description: The sequel to (and remake of) Street Fighter Alpha brings five new fighters into the fray including newcomer schoolgirl Sakura while adding a new special ability: the "Custom Combo", in which players can trigger a massive timed combo chain using their Super Meter.

title: Suikoden V
description: The fifth game in the Suikoden series. Set six years before Suikoden I, the game follows the Prince of the Queendom of Falena, as he struggles to unite the 108 Stars of Destiny and end a civil war that threatens to tear the realm apart.

title: Fatal Fury Special
description: The definitive version of Fatal Fury 2, improving both the game's speed and the playable character roster.

title: Medal of Honor
description:
Medal of Honor is the first title in the Medal of Honor series. The game was inspired by DreamWorks
Interactive co-founder Steven Spielberg. The game follows Jimmy Patterson a 24-
year old OSS operative as he infiltrates and sabotages Nazi War Machine during
the final days of WW II.

title: Shin Megami Tensei
description: The inaugural entry in the Shin Megami Tensei series and successor to Megami Tensei I and II on the Famicom. It follows a young man who must prove himself a hero after the opening of a demonic gate in Tokyo and the city's subsequent nuclear destruction.

title: Robo Army
description: A sci-fi brawler by SNK, pitting two lone cyborgs against an army of killer robotic humanoids.

title: Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse
description: Set over 200 years before the original game, the third installment of the Castlevania series tells the tale of Simon Belmont's ancestor Trevor, who seeks to destroy Dracula with the help of one of three possible companions.

title: Die Hard Trilogy
description: Die Hard Trilogy is a video game adaptation of the original trilogy of Die Hard films which star Bruce Willis as John McClane.

title: Breath of Fire III
description: Breath of Fire III is a popular Japanese RPG made by Capcom. The game follows the story of Ryu - who is trying to find out the secret behind his ability to change into a dragon.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney
description: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney follows a young attorney as he struggles to find his footing and live up to the legacy his mentor left him. Along the way, he encounters a cast of eccentric characters and tough cases.

title: Dragon Quest VI: Realms of Revelation
description: Dragon Quest VI: Realms of Revelation is the last in the Zenithia Trilogy of Dragon Quest remakes for the Nintendo DS. This was the first time in little over 15 years that Dragon Quest VI has made it to the United States in any form from the original Japanese SC.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
description: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess once again sees Link exploring the vast kingdom of Hyrule, this time in an attempt to dispel an evil twilight that has settled over the land.

title: Secret of Mana
description: An action RPG for the Super Nintendo and the second game in the Seiken Densetsu series. Secret of Mana can be played by up to three players simultaneously, and is widely regarded as one of the system's finest games.

title: World Heroes 2
description: ADK's signature fighting game series returns with new historical warriors, new gameplay techniques, and a revamped Death Match mode.

title: Shufflepuck Cafe
description: An air hockey game set in space that pits the unseen protagonist against various alien characters.

title: Bloody Roar
description: Bloody Roar is best known for its "zoanthrope" system, where each playable fighter has the ability to transform into a half-human half-animal creature with enhanced fighting abilities.

title: Virtua Fighter 3
description: The third installment of Sega-AM2's signature 3D fighting game series, Virtua Fighter 3 features one of the most advanced 3D graphical engines prior to the release of the Sega Dreamcast. It also introduces a variety of unique fighting game stage layouts, including environments with uneven grounds (such as stairways).

title: Super Mario Land
description: Princess Daisy of Sarasaland has been kidnapped by the evil alien Tatanga and it's up to Mario to rescue her in this handheld platformer (and launch title) for the original Game Boy.

title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
description: Ready 2 Rumble is Midway's drolly take on the video game boxing genre. It combines accessible arcade-like gameplay, with simulation-like skill building to deliver a slapstick and fun boxing entry.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics
description: Final Fantasy Tactics is an isometric turn-based strategy game with RPG elements set in the world of Ivalice. It follows the plight of Ramza Beoulve on his quest to obtain the 12 Zodiac Brave stones and stop the corrupt Church of Glabados from unleashing an ancient evil.

title: Vandal Hearts
description: Among one of the first tactical role-playing games to land on western shores, Vandal Hearts follows the trials and triumphs of Ash Lambert, and the oppressive conflict that threatens all of Sostegaria.

title: Paper Mario
description: The second Mario-themed RPG features a pop-up storybook aesthetic with flat paper characters. When the Seven Star Spirits are kidnapped by the forces of Bowser, it's up to Mario and his traveling companions to save the Mushroom Kingdom!

title: Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory!
description: The third numbered installment of the Fatal Fury series brings the fight back to South Town, replacing the original two-line system with a new swaying system while revamping the complete character roster.

title: Disney's Aladdin
description: Disney's Aladdin was the title of several different games from different developers based on the classic Disney film, Aladdin. As the titular character, players venture through many levels inspired by events and locations in the movie.

title: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere
description: The third installment in the Ace Combat flight simulator series which would become the standard for future Ace Combat games.

title: Jet Grind Radio
description: A young graffiti artist named Beat and his gang of inline-skating Rudies roam the cel-shaded streets of Tokyo-to while spraying tags, defeating rival gangs and evading a city-wide police crackdown.

title: Power Stone
description: Choose from eight different characters and do battle in large environments, picking up weapons and collecting Power Stones to transform yourself into a super warrior capable of massive damage.

title: Ultimate Ghosts 'N' Goblins
description: The fourth entry in Capcom's long-running Ghosts 'N Goblins series.

title: Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness
description: Powerful new alliances are formed as the Orcish invaders and Human kingdom of Lordaeron square off for land, sea, and air superiority.

title: Shining Force
description: A tactical RPG from Sega, the player has to save the land of Rune and stop the evil Darksol from reviving an evil that destroyed the world in ages past.

title: Master of Monsters: Disciples of Gaia
Saiyuki: Journey West
description: Saiyuki: Journey West is a turn based strategy game based on the Chinese novel "Journey to the West". A monk takes a pilgrimage to India with several unusual traveling companions in order to restore peace to the land.

title: Streets of Rage
description: When a once-peaceful city falls to crime and corruption, it's up to three ex-cops to take on the cause: a powerful criminal organization led by the sinister Mr. X.

title: Burnout
description: The first game in the Burnout series, 'Burnout' set the platform for a new generation of racing games, with a focus on speed, extravagant crashes, and a goal of driving as recklessly as possible.

title: Bleach: Dark Souls
description: Bleach: Dark Souls is a sequel to Bleach: The Blade of Fate. It features over more than 40 playable characters, seven new gameplay modes and new Bankai moves. It is the third Bleach game to be released in the United States.

title: Ōkami
description: Ōkami is an action-adventure game in which the goddess Amaterasu restores life and beauty to a world that has been taken over by malevolent beings through the power of celestial calligraphy techniques.

title: Super Smash Bros. Brawl
description: Strap on your fighting shoes and get ready to brawl on the Wii in the third installment of the Super Smash Bros. series.

title: God of War: Chains of Olympus
description: Kratos packs up and moves to the PSP in this first portable installment in the God of War series that serves as a prequel to the original.

title: Echochrome
description: A game available for download from the PlayStation Network Store. Gameplay involves controlling a mannequin type character through a world where physics and reality depend on perspective.

title: Mario Kart Wii
description: Get online and race in this Wii update of the long-running Mario Kart series. Mario Kart Wii is one of the best-selling games on the Nintendo Wii. It is the eighth installment of the series.

title: Final Fantasy XIII
description: This entry into the Final Fantasy universe is set in the worlds of Pulse and Cocoon. Players take control of multiple characters who are caught in a war between these worlds.

title: The World Ends with You
description: How does Japanese fashion collide with a pin that grants psychic powers? Square and Jupiter find out in The World Ends With You.

title: Ninja Gaiden
description: While the NES version may have become more famous, the original arcade version of Ninja Gaiden was an entirely different game, with more of a beat-'em-up feel.

title: Ninja Gaiden
description: Sega's 8-bit hardware received a unique game in the Ninja Gaiden series. It has similar gameplay to the NES trilogy, but is an all-new game, with a new story, different levels, and new gameplay mechanics, including a new wall-to-wall jump mechanic, which carried over to the later 3D games.

title: Double Dragon
description: A game credited, in part, with the popularity of the brawler genre in the arcade craze of the 1980s and 1990s.

title: N+
description: N+ is a challenging 2D platformer based off of the flash-based PC game. The goal is to get to the door as quickly as possible while collecting gold (time) and avoiding certain objects and enemies.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: The Turtles' first appearance on the NES followed the fighting foursome as they attempt to defeat the evil Shredder. Featuring challenging platforming elements and open-world levels, the game quickly became one of the NES's best-selling titles.

title: Final Fantasy IV
description: Final Fantasy IV is a critically acclaimed RPG in the Final Fantasy series and one of the first of its kind to tell a heavily character-driven story. It also created the Active Time Battle system.

title: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm
description: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm is an exclusive Playstation 3 game based on the acclaimed anime series.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 2009
description: Pro Evolution Soccer has been the mainstay of many a hardcore gamers with it's focus of game play and customization, particular popular in Asia and Western Europe where it has built a fanatical base of devoted editors and players alike.

title: Final Fantasy XV
description: The fifteenth entry in Square Enix's flagship RPG franchise, set in a world that mixes elements of modern technology with magic, a fantasy based on reality.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars
description: Take control of Huang Lee, the son of a Triad mob boss, in an destructive romp throughout Liberty City in his quest for revenge, money and honour in Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars.

title: Star Ocean: First Departure
description: Star Ocean: First Departure is a remake of the original Star Ocean for the SNES with revamped graphics, soundtrack, and added animated cutscenes for the Sony PSP.

title: Patapon 2
description: Patapon 2 is the sequel to the original critically acclaimed real-time musical/rhythm strategy game, Patapon.

title: Full Throttle
description: This post-apocalyptic adventure game from LucasArts follows a tough-as-nails biker named Ben, leader of the Polecats, a motorcycle gang.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3
description: The last game in the original "Budokai Tenkaichi" trilogy of fighting games based on the Dragon Ball manga and anime series, bringing the total character roster to over 140.

title: Tales of Symphonia
description: Tales of Symphonia is a cel-shaded action RPG and is another game in Namco's Tales series. It expands upon the series' battle system and emphasizes on relationships with other characters by the decisions you make throughout the game.

title: Batman: The Video Game
description: A licensed platformer based on the massively-successful 1989 superhero film. Sunsoft developed several different versions of the game which were released for both home and portable consoles.

title: Hokuto no Ken: Shinpan no Sousousei - Kengou Retsuden
description: Developed by the team behind the Guilty Gear series, Fist of the North Star is a fighting game adaptation of the hyper-violent post-apocalyptic manga and anime of the same name.

title: Sengoku Basara X
description: A fighting game spin-off of Capcom's Sengoku Basara series of games, from the studio behind the Guilty Gear series.

title: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja 3
description: The third installment of the Ultimate Ninja series (Narutimate Ninja in Japan), Naruto: Ultimate Ninja 3 is for the Playstation 2.

title: Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep
description: A PSP RPG from Square Enix in the Kingdom Hearts series that takes place roughly ten years prior to the original Kingdom Hearts, following Ventus, Aqua and Terra in their search for Master Xehanort...

title: Spider-Man
description: A action-adventure game based on the Spider-Man comics, that follows an original storyline and features narration from Stan Lee.

title: Dragon Quest IX: Sentinels of the Starry Skies
description: The most recent installment of the "Dragon Quest" franchise debuts exclusively on the DS.  It features 4 player co-op and turn-based combat.

title: BlazBlue: Calamity Trigger
description: Widely considered a spiritual successor to the studio's Guilty Gear series, BlazBlue is a fighting game with highly-detailed hand-drawn character graphics and a story involving sorcery and science.

title: Jump Ultimate Stars
description: The much improved sequel to Jump Superstars, Jump Ultimate Stars ups the ante with online play, a new koma system, even more characters and improved graphics.

title: Blazing Star
description: The sequel to the Neo Geo arcade shoot 'em up Pulstar revamps many of the original game's mechanics while adding five new ships to control, each with their own unique and dangerous assortment of weaponry.

title: Guilty Gear Judgment
description: A PSP spin-off of Arc System Works's signature fighting game series, combining the series's fighting game mechanics with belt-scrolling beat-'em-up gameplay. It also includes a port of Guilty Gear XX (#Reload or Slash) as a bonus.

title: Viewpoint
description: A space shooter developed by Sammy with an isometric viewpoint, similar to the 1982 classic Zaxxon.

title: Tobal No. 1
description: The first game by DreamFactory, Tobal No. 1 is a 3D fighting game published by SquareSoft and features characters designed by Akira Toriyama (of Dragon Ball fame) and a bonus action-RPG game mode.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Butoden
description: One of the earliest fighting games to bear the Dragon Ball license, adding new concepts to the burgeoning fighting game genre (including a roaming split-screen view for less restrictive playfields).

title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Butoden 2
description: The second installment of the Super Butoden series improves the graphical and gameplay style of its predecessor and is one of the earliest games in the series to focus on storylines from the Dragon Ball animated films.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Butoden 3
description: The third and final installment of the original Super Butoden trilogy brings the series to the Majin Buu Saga of the Dragon Ball Z storyline.

title: Street Fighter III: New Generation
description: After numerous iterations of Street Fighter II (and its spin-off Street Fighter Alpha series), Capcom continues its classic fighting game series with a new cast of fighters, a higher-quality graphical style, and revamped gameplay mechanics (introducing the "parry" and "Super Art" systems).

title: Dragon Ball Z: Shin Butoden
description: A spin-off of the Super Butoden series made for the Sega Saturn, featuring the roster and character graphics from the earlier PlayStation spin-off and gameplay more in-line with the original trilogy.

title: The 3rd Birthday
description: The 3rd Birthday revisits the cult 90s favorite Parasite Eve and updates it with more action-orientated gameplay, heavy RPG elements, and a new story.

title: Daytona USA
description: One of Sega's signature arcade racing games, loosely based on stock car racing events at the Daytona International Speedway.

title: Street Racer
description: Up to eight players can race over twenty-seven courses, rumble in a battle arena or play car soccer in this multiplatform cart racer.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Shin Budokai
description: A handheld spin-off of the Dragon Ball Z: Budokai games (and the first Dragon Ball game released for the PlayStation Portable), Shin Budokai ties in with the animated film Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn (and was released in tandem with the film's English dub).

title: Street Fighter III: 2nd Impact
description: The second iteration of Street Fighter III, updating the original game while adding three new combatants and a new gameplay mechanic ("EX Special Moves").

title: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box
description:
The second adventure for Professor Hershel Layton and his helpful assistant Luke.  They must solve riddles to reveal the mystery surrounding a box that seemingly kills whoever opens it.
In Europe, the game was released as "Professor Layton and Pandora's Box"

title: Professor Layton and the Unwound Future
description: The third installment in the Professor Layton series. A puzzle solving game that follows a unique storyline involving time travel.

title: Macross Digital Mission VF-X
description: Macross flying game

title: The Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
description: A Macross game based on the film of the same name.

title: Macross VF-X 2
description: Psone sequel of the Macross flying game, with a new story, characters and valkyrie models.

title: The Legend of Oasis
description: An action RPG for the Sega Saturn, the sequel to the Genesis game Beyond Oasis.  Known in Europe as The Story of Thor and The Story of Thor 2 respectively.

title: Dragon Quest IV: Chapters of the Chosen
description: Embark on an adventure with characters from different walks of life, all destined to unite with you, to save the world.

title: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja
description: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja is the first Naruto fighting game on the PS2.

title: Batman: Arkham Asylum
description: Batman: Arkham Asylum puts you behind the cowl of the iconic Dark Knight, fighting his way through Arkham Asylum to stop the Joker from enacting a sinister plot that would have grave consequences for Gotham City.

title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story
description: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story is the third installment in the whimsical Mario & Luigi franchise by AlphaDream & Nintendo. Mario and Luigi must save the Mushroom Kingdom from the evil doings of Fawful, with the unknowing help of King Bowser.

title: Muramasa: The Demon Blade
description: A 2D action game from the creators of Odin Sphere, featuring a hand-drawn, watercolor Japanese art style. Originally released on the Wii, it has since received an enhanced port for the PS Vita.

title: Mytran Wars
description: A turn based strategy game where you can learn new technologies and re-arm your mecha.

title: Disgaea 2: Dark Hero Days
description: A port of the original Disgaea 2: Cursed Memories to the PSP along with some additional features.

title: Pier Solar
description: Pier Solar is a fan made RPG for Mega Drive / Genesis released in 2010, available only through the Pier Solar website.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja 4
description: Ultimate Ninja 4 takes place two and a half years after the end of the original Naruto series.

title: Beaterator
description: Beaterator is a portable music maker produced by Rockstar in conjunction with Timbaland.

title: Bleach: Heat the Soul 6
description: The sixth installment in Sony's series of fighting games based on the popular anime/manga series.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks
description: Set 100 years after the events of The Wind Waker and Phantom Hourglass, Spirit Tracks introduces a new Hyrule where technology has advanced to the steam age, and an evil force, long-sealed in a tower, has been freed.

title: Ys SEVEN
description: The seventh installment in the Ys series, a fast paced action-packed RPG that lets the player fight enemies in real time with a team of three active characters.

title: Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny
description: The weapon-based fighting franchise makes its way to handhelds for the first time, featuring 20 unique characters, expanded character creation, and multiple gameplay modes.

title: Dragon Ball: Raging Blast
description: A spiritual successor to the "Budokai Tenkaichi" fighting game series based on the Dragon Ball manga and anime series, bringing Spike's gameplay to seventh-generation consoles.

title: FIFA 10
description: FIFA 10 is EA Sports' 2009-2010 edition of the successful football game franchise.

title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
description: The first 2D Mario platformer for a home console in over 15 years. Though it has single-player, it focuses heavily on cooperative multiplayer, allowing up to 4 players to play simultaneously. This game also premiered Nintendo's Super Guide hint system.

title: Wii Fit Plus
description: Wii Fit Plus is technically not a sequel as it is an enhanced version/expansion of the original game released the previous year. It contains new activities, a calorie counter, and several set routines to add to the Wii Fit experience.

title: Valkyria Chronicles II
description: This PSP title is the sequel to Valkyria Chronicles and takes place during a civil war that breaks out following the events of the original game.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja 5
description: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja 5 is the 5th installment in the Ultimate Ninja series.

title: Disney Epic Mickey
description: Oswald the Rabbit and Mickey Mouse battle it out in Warren Spector's re-imagining of Walt Disney's universe in Epic Mickey.

title: Saint Seiya: The Sanctuary
description: Saint Seiya: The Sanctuary ties in 3D fighting with storylines from the Saint Seiya manga series and cut scenes from the anime.

title: Saint Seiya: The Hades
description: A 3D fighting game with characters and storylines from the Saint Seiya franchise.

title: Phantasy Star Portable 2
description: Sequel to Phantasy Star Portable for the PSP, the game supports both local and online multi-player.

title: Resident Evil
description: A remake of the first game in the pre-eminent video game horror series, featuring a graphics overhaul, as well as several new gameplay features, environments, and unlockable modes that weren't included within the original version.

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3 Portable
description: Persona 3 Portable is an enhanced port of Persona 3 for PSP. New features include an additional female protagonist as well as certain gameplay adjustments introduced in Persona 4.

title: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask
description: The 5th installment in the Professor Layton Franchise, and the first on the Nintendo 3DS.

title: PixelJunk Monsters Deluxe
description: PixelJunk Monsters Deluxe is a "best-of" style sequel to the popular PSN tower defense series where you build up your defenses to protect your base against threatening monsters.

title: Zettai Hero Project: Unlosing Ranger vs. Darkdeath Evilman
description: A dungeon role-playing game from the makers of Disgaea.

title: Tales of Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon X
description: Tales of Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon Cross is a remake of the dungeon-crawler spin-off Tales of Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon with an updated battle system. It's also a cross compilation including the full voice version of Tales of Phantasia previously released on PSP, which also features some enhancements to its combat system.

title: Patchwork Heroes
description: You must dismantle each level's warship quickly before the ships can strike, and rescue trapped comrades along the way.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2
description: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2 is a fighting game based on the popular anime and manga series, Naruto.

title: The Eye of Judgment: Legends
description: Eye of Judgment Legends introduces a story campaign and rebalanced cards. Unlike the Eye of Judgment game for PS3, this version does not require the purchase of a camera accessory or physical cards.

title: Bleach: Heat the Soul 7
description: The newest game in the 'Heat the Soul' PSP series, based on the popular anime/manga Bleach.

title: God of War: Ghost of Sparta
description: God of War: Ghost of Sparta bridges the gap between the first and second God of War, and is the second entry for the franchise on the PSP platform.

title: Dragon Ball: Raging Blast 2
description: The sequel to Dragon Ball: Raging Blast, bringing a new art style, new gameplay modes, and 26 new playable characters and transformations (most of whom are from the Dragon Ball Z animated films and specials).

title: FIFA 11
description: FIFA 11 is the yearly, best selling football (soccer) game by EA Sports. FIFA 11 features 11 v 11 online multiplayer and the ability to play as a goalkeeper.

title: Mario Kart 7
description: The first stereoscopic 3D edition of the premiere Kart Racing series starring Nintendo's famous mascots and the seventh home release in the franchise (ninth overall). It has a new first-person mode and kart customizations.

title: BlazBlue: Continuum Shift II
description: An arcade revision of BlazBlue: Continuum Shift, including some gameplay balance tweaks and the inclusion of some characters from the Console version Continuum Shift. Much of the revision was brought back to the previous Console version, as well as some additional handheld ports.

title: Arc Arena: Monster Tournament
description: A PlayStation spin-off of the Arc the Lad series.

title: FIFA 12
description: FIFA 12 is set to be EA Sports' 2011 iteration of the franchise, covering the 2011-2012 season and will introduce tactical defending, precision dribbling and enhanced AI.

title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past & Four Swords
description: A Game Boy Advance remake of the SNES classic featuring an all new Four Swords multiplayer component.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky SC
description: The direct sequel to The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky and the seventh entry in Falcom's Legend of Heroes series.

title: Mario Party 9
description: Mario Party 9 is the twelfth game in the long-running Nintendo board game series. Wii Party developer NDCube takes over from Hudson, attempting to refresh the series with some significant gameplay changes.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations
description: The newest installment of the Naruto fighting games. Featuring over 70 characters from Part I & Part II.

title: FIFA Soccer 13
description: The latest installment in EA Sports' FIFA series, featuring updated rosters, technical improvements, a more robust feature set for Support Your Club, and a new First Touch mechanic.

title: One Piece: Grand Battle!
description: Grand Battle! is the first in a series of fighting games based on the anime and manga One Piece.

title: Tennis
description: The classic game of Tennis for the Game Boy, originally release in 1989. Features four skill levels.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Rockstar returns to the fictional state of San Andreas with a crew of three criminal protagonists who work together to pull off high-profile heists.

title: Muv-Luv Alternative
description: This sequel to the sci-fi visual novel Muv-Luv has protagonist Takeru Shirogane reliving the events of the previous game. But being aware of what is ahead, he hopes to change things for the better and give humanity a chance against the alien onslaught.

title: The Simpsons: Tapped Out
description: Rebuild Springfield however you see fit in this iOS and Android game.

title: Captain Tsubasa J: Get In The Tomorrow
description: The first Captain Tsubasa game released on the Playstation.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Aratanaru Densetsu Joshou
description: Released in 2002 for the PlayStation.

title: Hokuto no Ken: Seiki Matsukyu Seishi Densetsu
description: A Hokuto no Ken game for the original PlayStation, where the player controls Kenshiro through his journey of the manga/anime.

title: JoJo's Venture
description: The first fighting game adaptation of the shōnen manga series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, re-telling the series' famous Stardust Crusaders arc as a squad travels to Egypt in the late-1980's to use their supernatural "Stand" powers against the forces of a reawakened vampire.

title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
description: The final main entry in the Metal Gear Solid series bridges the events between Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and the original Metal Gear, as Big Boss wakes up from a nine-year coma in 1984 to rebuild his mercenary paradise.

title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes
description: The denizens of the Marvel Universe battle it out LEGO style.

title: Geronimo Stilton in the Kingdom of Fantasy
description: An epic adventure filled with stories and puzzles.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: The first HD installment of the Zelda series developed for the Wii U and Nintendo Switch that returns to the open-world design of the original NES title, with a focus on free exploration of a large scale environment as well as dangerous enemies.

title: FIFA 14
description: The 2014 installment in EA Canada's soccer simulation franchise. This was the first in the franchise to bridge the 360/PS3 to Xbox One/PS4 gap.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 Full Burst
description: A director's cut edition of Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 3, and Naruto's official PC game debut.

title: Bravely Default
description: An enhanced version of Bravely Default: Flying Fairy. This edition was localized and released internationally, as opposed to the original Flying Fairy.

title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse
description: A fighting game for PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox 360, Xbox One, and PC set in the Dragon Ball Z universe.

title: Final Fantasy: Record Keeper
description: Relive some of the Final Fantasy series' most memorable battles with 16-bit(-ish) sprites and mix-and-match party gameplay.

title: Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age
description: The eleventh main entry in the long-running RPG series returns to its pre-MMO roots.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4
description: The Naruto series jumps to eighth generation consoles with the fourth sequential installment of the Ultimate Ninja Storm series.

title: Hollow Knight
description: A 2D exploration action adventure game, developed by Team Cherry.

title: Fire Emblem Fates
description: Fire Emblem Fates is the fourteenth overall game of the Fire Emblem series, and the second to be released on the Nintendo 3DS. It comes in three separate campaigns based around the player choosing sides in a war between two kingdoms.

title: Hunter X Hunter: Maboroshi no Greed Island
description: Hunter X Hunter: Maboroshi no Greed Island is a PlayStation Role-Playing entry in the Hunter X Hunter series.

title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
description: Teased since the PlayStation 3's debut, Square Enix finally delivers a complete remake of the fan favorite Final Fantasy from 1997.

title: Tekken 7: Fated Retribution
description: The definitive version of Tekken 7 (and the one ported to home consoles), featuring a dedicated story mode that concludes the rivalry between Kazuya and Heihachi.

title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2
description: A second time-traveling romp through the DragonBall series.

title: God of War
description: God of War is a soft reboot on the franchise of the same name. It sees Kratos and his son Atreus traverse a world of Norse myths.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man
description: An Insomniac game exclusively for PlayStation 4 where Spider-Man strives to stop Mister Negative's terrorist plot against the city of New York.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Collection
description: A collection of the Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm games.

title: Super Mario Odyssey
description: Nintendo's favorite plumber and his new hat-shaped companion travel far beyond the Mushroom Kingdom in this Switch-exclusive 3D platformer.

title: LEGO Harry Potter Collection
description: Both LEGO Harry Potter games have been remastered for PlayStaton 4 & Xbox One

title: 1-2-Switch
description: A multiplayer game for Nintendo Switch that focuses on face-to-face interactions rather than watching the screen.

title: Octopath Traveler
description: A role-playing game developed exclusively for the Nintendo Switch. Throughout the adventure, the player can recruit eight different heroes, each with their own unique storyline.

title: Fire Emblem: Three Houses
description: The sixteenth mainline Fire Emblem game that features support troops on the battlefield, the player character encountering three protagonists with their own factions, and fully explorable 3D locations.

title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2
description: Kang the Conqueror threatens the Lego Marvel Multiverse in Lego Marvel Super Heroes 2.

title: Dragon Ball FighterZ
description: From the developers of the Guilty Gear Xrd series of fighting games comes a more traditional tag-team fighting game adaptation of the Dragon Ball manga and anime.

title: Just Dance 2018
description: The ninth main installment of Ubisoft's dancing game.

title: Pokémon Sword/Shield
description: Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield is a RPG game for the Nintendo Switch which is set in the Galar region.

title: The LEGO Ninjago Movie Video Game
description: The video game based on the movie based on the toy series "Ninjago", from LEGO.

title: Dragon Quest Builders 2
description: The sequel to Square-Enix' world-building Dragon Quest game.

title: Bayonetta 3
description: The third entry in the Bayonetta series comes to Nintendo Switch.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
description: The Switch debut of Nintendo's flagship fighting game series brings together every character from the series' history, bringing the roster to over 70 fighters.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 6
description: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (also known as World Soccer: Winning Eleven 10 and World Soccer: Winning Eleven X for Xbox 360 in Japan and South Korea, Winning Eleven: Pro Evolution Soccer 2007 in the United States) is a video game developed and published by Konami.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 2019
description: PES 2019 boasts huge addition of licensed leagues alongside improvements for player animation, Master League and an overhauled MyClub.

title: Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!/Eevee!
description: The first "core" Pokémon game for Switch and an enhanced remake of Pokémon Yellow.

title: Luigi's Mansion 3
description: Luigi has to once again save Mario and friends from a ghostly and gooey nightmare, this time in a haunted hotel.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
