description: Transform a deserted island into a paradise in the Switch's version of Animal Crossing.

title: Hades
description: Hades is a rogue-like dungeon crawler in which you defy the god of death as you hack and slash your way out of the Underworld of Greek myth.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
description: A full remake of the Game Boy classic on Nintendo Switch.

title: Space Adventure Cobra: The Shooting
description: A 3D action game based on Buichi Terasawa's classic science fiction manga Space Adventure COBRA.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
description: A direct sequel to Breath of the Wild, featuring a completely new set of abilities and expanding the world to the skies above and caverns below the surface.

title: eFootball PES 2020
description: The Pro Evolution Soccer series undergoes a rebranding for 2020.

title: Genshin Impact
description: A free-to-play open world action/role-playing game.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition
description:
The Defintitive Edition of this 2010 Wii game is a cosmetic remake with a remastered soundtrack and several quality of life changes, bringing this classic into high definition with MonolithSoft's latest engine tech for its 10 year anniversary. 
With Future Connected, it also features a standalone epilogue set in a new area that had been cut from the game during the original development.

title: Ring Fit Adventure
description: A fitness/RPG experience for Nintendo Switch using the Ring-Con and Leg Strap accessory.

title: Bravely Default II
description: Bravely Default II is a turn-based role-playing game that features four new Heroes of Light in a brand new world called Excillant.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
description: The second entry in Insomniac Games' Spider-Man franchise shifts the focus from Peter Parker to Miles Morales.

title: Horizon Forbidden West
description: Aloy ventures to the west coast of what was formerly America in this sequel to 2017's Horizon Zero Dawn.

title: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2: The Ultimate Puzzle Crossover
description: A sequel to Puyo Puyo Tetris, featuring a returning cast of characters and a simultaneous global release.

title: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Hogwarts Legacy is a role-playing game set in the Harry Potter universe.

title: Triangle Strategy
description: From the makers of Octopath Traveler, a tactical RPG with a branching narrative.

title: Splatoon 3
description: Splatoon 3 sends players to battle the Octarian army in the Splatlands.

title: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis
description: A single-player mobile game that covers the entire timeline of the Final Fantasy VII franchise including Advent Children, Before Crisis, Crisis Core, and Dirge of Cerberus.

title: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
description: Pokémon Legends: Arceus is an open-world RPG by Game Freak, which takes place in the distant past of the franchise's Sinnoh region.

title: Pokémon Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl
description: Remakes of Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, for the Nintendo Switch.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge
description: A 2D beat 'em up based on the 80's Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles series.

title: Super Robot Wars 30
description: A title celebrating 30 years of the Super Robot Taisen/Wars series.

title: eFootball 2022
description: Konami's storied Pro Evolution Soccer franchise fully transitions to a free-to-play, ongoing game with a new name.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
description: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 sees the return of Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they team up to face Venom and Kraven the Hunter.

title: Pokémon Scarlet/Violet
description: The ninth generation Pokémon games.

title: Super Mario RPG
description: A full remake of the 1996's SNES collaboration between Sqauresoft and Nintendo.

title: Princess Peach Showtime!
description: In June 2023, Nintendo announced that a Princess Peach game was in development and scheduled for release in 2024. This is only the second time Peach has had her own game after Super Princess Peach in 2005.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
description: A successor to the New Super Mario Bros. series, bringing Mario and his friends to the wondrous Flower Kingdom for a new side-scrolling adventure!
